RaYN97yk.name: 蛛行
RaYN97yk.description: 蜘蛛可以爬越困難表面，包括倒吊在天花板上，而無須進行屬性檢定。

4BqEvxpT.name: 蛛網感知
4BqEvxpT.description: 當與蛛網保持接觸時，蜘蛛可以知道任何其他與同一張蛛網接觸生物的確切位置。

YxqJ3MKZ.name: 蛛網行者
YxqJ3MKZ.description: 蜘蛛無視蛛網所造成的移動限制。

g3Wesr1S.name: g3Wesr1S
g3Wesr1S.description: mw 命中3，觸及0呎，單一處於集群所在位置的生物。on hit: 10 (4d4)穿刺傷害，或若集群的生命值等於或低於一半時則造成5 (2d4)穿刺傷害。

Jp39lc74.name: 集群
Jp39lc74.description: 集群可以佔據另一個生物所在的空間，反之亦然。且集群可以穿過任何足以讓一隻微型昆蟲通過的開口。集群無法回復生命值或獲得臨時生命值。

LmrIwsq8.name: LmrIwsq8
LmrIwsq8.description: mw 命中3，觸及0呎，單一處於集群所在位置的生物。on hit: 10 (4d4)穿刺傷害，或若集群的生命值等於或低於一半時則造成5 (2d4)穿刺傷害。

sQZqAu4w.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
sQZqAu4w.description: 若泰拉斯奎巨獸在一次豁免檢定中失敗，它可以選擇改為使其成功。

Yaw0uZsx.name: 魔法抗性
Yaw0uZsx.description: 泰拉斯奎巨獸在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

0Xcv7jhF.name: 反射甲殼
0Xcv7jhF.description: 任何時候當泰拉斯奎巨獸成為一個魔法飛彈法術、直線區域法術、或一個要求進行遠程攻擊檢定法術的目標時，骰一顆d6。若擲骰結果為1到5，則泰拉斯奎巨獸將不受影響。若結果為6，泰拉斯奎巨獸不受影響，且該效果將被反射回施法者，就如同其源自於泰拉斯奎巨獸並將施法者變為該法術的目標。

6RPkaKUq.name: 攻城怪物
6RPkaKUq.description: 泰拉斯奎巨獸對物體和建築物造成兩倍的傷害。

wyMuBHon.name: wyMuBHon
wyMuBHon.description: 泰拉斯奎巨獸可以使用它的駭人威儀。它接著進行五次攻擊：一次啃咬，二次爪抓，一次角擊，和一次尾擊。它可以使用它的吞嚥以取代啃咬攻擊。

z6SUlKZ7.name: z6SUlKZ7
z6SUlKZ7.description: mw 命中19，觸及10呎，單一目標。on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個生物，則它將被擒(逃脫DC 20)。直到擒抱結束前，目標被束縛，且泰拉斯奎巨獸不能再啃咬另一個目標。

DCpoMrge.name: DCpoMrge
DCpoMrge.description: mw 命中19，觸及15呎，單一目標。on hit: 28 (4d8 + 10)劈砍傷害。

UQuPyneh.name: UQuPyneh
UQuPyneh.description: mw 命中19，觸及10呎，單一目標。on hit: 32 (4d10 + 10)穿刺傷害。

PQr16MpV.name: PQr16MpV
PQr16MpV.description: mw 命中19，觸及20呎，單一目標。on hit: 24 (4d6 + 10)鈍擊傷害。若目標為一個生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 20的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。

QhjJ9uEv.name: QhjJ9uEv
QhjJ9uEv.description: 每個距離泰拉斯奎巨獸120呎內，由泰拉斯奎巨獸所選擇的且意識到其存在的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 17的睿知豁免，否則將陷入恐懼長達1分鐘。一個生物可以在它的每個回合結束時重複這個豁免檢定，若泰拉斯奎巨獸在它的視線內則此檢定具有劣勢，若檢定成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。若一個生物成功通過該豁免檢定或結束這個效果對它的影響，則該生物將在接下來的24小時內免疫此泰拉斯奎巨獸的駭人威儀。

IPR1c3zq.name: IPR1c3zq
IPR1c3zq.description: 泰拉斯奎巨獸對一個它正擒抱，且體型為大型或更小的目標進行一次啃咬攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則目標將受到啃咬傷害並被吞嚥，且擒抱結束。在被吞嚥時，目標將陷入目盲和束縛，它對泰拉斯奎巨獸外的攻擊和其他效果有全掩護，且在每次泰拉斯奎巨獸的回合開始時受到56 (16d6)酸蝕傷害。

8gqEbw5J.name: 變色甲殼
8gqEbw5J.description: 斯里克林螳螂人可以改變它甲殼的顏色以模擬周遭環境的色彩與質感。因此，它在為躲藏所進行的敏捷（隱匿）檢定中具有優勢。

WNrzI6xB.name: 立定跳躍
WNrzI6xB.description: 斯里克林螳螂人的跳遠距離最多30呎、且跳高距離最多15呎，無論有沒有助跑都一樣。

ecpl6A2V.name: ecpl6A2V
ecpl6A2V.description: 斯里克林螳螂人進行二次攻擊：一次啃咬，一次爪抓。

ut5rW0kh.name: ut5rW0kh
ut5rW0kh.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1)穿刺傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次DC 11的體質豁免，否則陷入中毒狀態長達1分鐘。若此豁免檢定失敗且結果與目標值差距5點或更多，則因此中毒的目標也將連帶陷入麻痺狀態。中毒的目標可以在它的每個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定，若檢定成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。

V8BmbtRC.name: V8BmbtRC
V8BmbtRC.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (2d4 + 1)劈砍傷害。

Thri-kreen(Psionic).name: 斯里克林螳螂人(靈能) Thri-kreen (Psionic)

GRzQtaIH.name: 變色甲殼
GRzQtaIH.description: 斯里克林螳螂人可以改變它甲殼的顏色以模擬周遭環境的色彩與質感。因此，它在為躲藏所進行的敏捷（隱匿）檢定中具有優勢。

Z0xdiQwG.name: 立定跳躍
Z0xdiQwG.description: 斯里克林螳螂人的跳遠距離最多30呎、且跳高距離最多15呎，無論有沒有助跑都一樣。

pb5HPo6z.name: pb5HPo6z
pb5HPo6z.description: 斯里克林螳螂人進行二次攻擊：一次啃咬，一次爪抓。

Zhw2JODe.name: Zhw2JODe
Zhw2JODe.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1)穿刺傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次DC 11的體質豁免，否則陷入中毒狀態長達1分鐘。若此豁免檢定失敗且結果與目標值差距5點或更多，則因此中毒的目標也將連帶陷入麻痺狀態。中毒的目標可以在它的每個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定，若檢定成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。

cezTMojs.name: cezTMojs
cezTMojs.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (2d4 + 1)劈砍傷害。

Dy7r8d9v.name: 群體戰術
Dy7r8d9v.description: 若暴徒有至少一個隊友距離目標生物5呎內且該隊友並未無力，則暴徒在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

flD9ILzy.name: flD9ILzy
flD9ILzy.description: 暴徒進行二次近戰攻擊。

DXjWS47r.name: DXjWS47r
DXjWS47r.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)鈍擊傷害。

H2Axonf1.name: H2Axonf1
H2Axonf1.description: rw 命中2，射程100/400呎，單一目標。on hit: 5 (1d10)穿刺傷害。

RBygWQoT.name: 敏銳嗅覺
RBygWQoT.description: 老虎在依賴嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

jcb5gSNC.name: 猛撲
jcb5gSNC.description: 若老虎向著一個生物直線移動至少20呎並接著在同回合以一次爪抓攻擊命中它，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 13的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。若目標伏地，則老虎能夠以一次附贈動作對它進行一次啃咬攻擊。

5J3fZEi4.name: 5J3fZEi4
5J3fZEi4.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3)穿刺傷害。

wExRsMa6.name: wExRsMa6
wExRsMa6.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)劈砍傷害。

h8GyuRm4.name: 擬形
h8GyuRm4.description: 當樹人保持不動，它看起來就跟普通的樹木一模一樣。

YFn0cMkh.name: 攻城怪物
YFn0cMkh.description: 樹人對物體和建築物造成兩倍的傷害。

6zPAqWvu.name: 6zPAqWvu
6zPAqWvu.description: 樹人進行二次猛擊攻擊。

2hgST7jW.name: 2hgST7jW
2hgST7jW.description: mw 命中10，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 16 (3d6 + 6)鈍擊傷害。

VlXfgcCh.name: VlXfgcCh
VlXfgcCh.description: rw 命中10，射程60/180呎，單一目標。on hit: 28 (4d10 + 6)鈍擊傷害。

Ddu0SVYr.name: Ddu0SVYr
Ddu0SVYr.description: 樹人用魔法活化一棵或二棵距離它60呎內且它所能看見的樹木。這些樹木將具有和樹人相同的數據，但它們的智力和魅力值為1，無法說話，且只擁有猛擊的動作項。被活化的樹木將做為樹人的盟友行動。這些樹木將維持活化長達1天，或直到它死亡、樹人死亡、或樹人距離該樹木超過120呎，或直到樹人以一個附贈動作將其變回普通樹木。接著若可能的話，這棵樹木將會原地扎根。

wCOYL67G.name: 群體戰術
wCOYL67G.description: 若勇士有至少一個隊友距離目標生物5呎內且該隊友並未無力，則勇士在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

1TqvYthO.name: 1TqvYthO
1TqvYthO.description: mw,rw 命中3，觸及5呎 或 射程20/60呎，單一目標。on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1)穿刺傷害，或若雙手使用以進行一次近戰攻擊時則造成 5 (1d8 + 1)穿刺傷害。

9kOiFJf5.name: 踐踏衝鋒
9kOiFJf5.description: 若三角龍向著一個生物直線移動至少20呎並接著在同回合以一次角撞攻擊命中它，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 13的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。若目標伏地，則三角龍能夠以一次附贈動作對它進行一次踩踏攻擊。

poIuhjsH.name: poIuhjsH
poIuhjsH.description: mw 命中9，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 24 (4d8 + 6)穿刺傷害。

28OjsJPA.name: 28OjsJPA
28OjsJPA.description: mw 命中9，觸及5呎，單一伏地生物。on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6)鈍擊傷害。

6Fyjvqh4.name: 公理之念
6Fyjvqh4.description: 三元冢無法被強迫去進行違背其天性或指示的行動。

N4yVDka5.name: 解體
N4yVDka5.description: 若三元冢死亡，它的身體將瓦解成塵，留下它的武器和任何它所攜帶的其它東西。

DmptV1fX.name: DmptV1fX
DmptV1fX.description: 三元冢進行三次拳擊攻擊或三次標槍攻擊。

6VPnsyYZ.name: 6VPnsyYZ
6VPnsyYZ.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1)鈍擊傷害。

QJe9aH86.name: QJe9aH86
QJe9aH86.description: mw,rw 命中3，觸及5呎 或 射程30/120呎，單一目標。on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1)穿刺傷害。

by6REz7c.name: 變色皮膚
by6REz7c.description: 戰蜥人在為躲藏所進行的敏捷（隱匿）檢定中具有優勢。

tDcHCzxg.name: 惡臭
tDcHCzxg.description: 任何除了戰蜥人以外在距離戰蜥人5呎內開始它回合的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則陷入中毒狀態直到該生物的下個回合開始。若此豁免成功，該生物將免疫於所有戰蜥人的惡臭長達1小時。

ruGgFWf9.name: 日光敏感
ruGgFWf9.description: 當處於日光照耀下時，戰蜥人在攻擊檢定，以及依賴視覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有劣勢。

dAwBhKa3.name: dAwBhKa3
dAwBhKa3.description: 戰蜥人進行三次攻擊：一次啃咬，二次爪抓。

YFLUzb8w.name: YFLUzb8w
YFLUzb8w.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2)穿刺傷害。

ZtwocPlz.name: ZtwocPlz
ZtwocPlz.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2)劈砍傷害。

RfQLbWkp.name: 敏銳嗅覺
RfQLbWkp.description: 巨魔在依賴嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

3EqRCj6v.name: 再生
3EqRCj6v.description: 巨魔在它的回合開始時回復10點生命值。若巨魔受到酸蝕或火焰傷害，則這個特性在巨魔下個回合開始時並不會發揮作用。巨魔只會在它以0點生命值開始它回合，且再生並未發揮效果時死亡。

q6zmixdl.name: q6zmixdl
q6zmixdl.description: 巨魔進行三次攻擊：一次啃咬，二次爪抓。

UXnD9tIO.name: UXnD9tIO
UXnD9tIO.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4)穿刺傷害。

mRb1lXuT.name: mRb1lXuT
mRb1lXuT.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4)劈砍傷害。

OqVNBd0f.name: 擬形
OqVNBd0f.description: 當枯枝怪保持不動，它看起來就跟枯死的灌木叢一模一樣。

XLgS3hC2.name: 盲視
XLgS3hC2.value: 60呎（超過半徑範圍則視作目盲）

cqI6kVRb.name: cqI6kVRb
cqI6kVRb.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1)穿刺傷害。

kG6HlEBN.name: kG6HlEBN
kG6HlEBN.description: 霸王龍進行二次攻擊：一次啃咬，一次尾擊。牠不能對同一個目標進行這二次攻擊。

FyHiN6nx.name: FyHiN6nx
FyHiN6nx.description: mw 命中10，觸及10呎，單一目標。on hit: 33 (4d12 + 7)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個體型為中型或更小的生物，則它被擒(逃脫DC 17)。直到擒抱結束前，目標被束縛，且霸王龍不能對另一個目標使用啃咬。

96ldLMtE.name: 96ldLMtE
96ldLMtE.description: mw 命中10，觸及10呎，單一目標。on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7)鈍擊傷害。

V6Q3o85U.name: 魔法抗性
V6Q3o85U.description: 烏特羅斯魔在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

6a5hV1zL.name: 魔法武器
6a5hV1zL.description: 烏特羅斯魔的武器攻擊視作魔法攻擊。

2ea8ZADI.name: 2ea8ZADI
2ea8ZADI.description: 烏特羅斯魔可以使用它的催眠凝視，並進行三次近戰攻擊。

KAqzpluN.name: KAqzpluN
KAqzpluN.description: mw 命中8，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)劈砍傷害，或若以雙手使用則造成 8 (1d10 + 3)劈砍傷害。

fq3yA97z.name: fq3yA97z
fq3yA97z.description: 烏特羅斯魔的雙眼綻放出乳白色的光芒，選擇一個距離它30呎內且它所能看見的生物做為目標。若該目標可以看見烏特羅斯魔，則該目標必須成功通過一次對抗這個魔法的DC 17的睿知豁免，否則被魅惑直到該烏特羅斯魔的下個回合結束。這個被魅惑的生物同時陷入震懾狀態。若目標的豁免檢定成功，目標將在接下來的24小時內免疫於該烏特羅斯魔的催眠凝視。

Lt9E6nMd.name: Lt9E6nMd
Lt9E6nMd.description: 烏特羅斯魔用魔法將自己連同任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備一起傳送最多60呎距離到一處它所能看見的未被佔據空間。

QOA46reG.name: 困惑凝視
QOA46reG.description: 當一個生物在距離土巨怪30呎內，且能看見土巨怪雙眼的位置開始它的回合，則除非土巨怪處於無力，可以使用魔法迫使它進行一次DC 15的魅力豁免。

Hu3ejUMo.name: 掘道者
Hu3ejUMo.description: 土巨怪能夠以它掘地速度一半的速度掘穿堅硬的岩層，並在身後留下一個5呎寬，8呎高的地道。

QVcIpUwo.name: QVcIpUwo
QVcIpUwo.description: 土巨怪進行三次攻擊：二次爪抓，一次大顎。

nJUW4MiB.name: nJUW4MiB
nJUW4MiB.description: mw 命中8，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5)劈砍傷害。

8HniN6Q9.name: 8HniN6Q9
8HniN6Q9.description: mw 命中8，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5)劈砍傷害。

1SXMIGzi.name: 衝鋒
1SXMIGzi.description: 若獨角獸向著一個目標直線移動至少20呎並接著在同回合以一次角擊攻擊命中它，則目標將受到額外的9 (2d8)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 15的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。

Yx5KLHzf.name: 魔法抗性
Yx5KLHzf.description: 獨角獸在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

9GH632Kj.name: 魔法武器
9GH632Kj.description: 獨角獸的武器攻擊視作魔法攻擊。

L4RrwqDQ.name: L4RrwqDQ
L4RrwqDQ.description: 獨角獸進行二次攻擊：一次蹄擊，一次角擊。

PzZs7eSE.name: PzZs7eSE
PzZs7eSE.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4)鈍擊傷害。

6B0GbAyp.name: 6B0GbAyp
6B0GbAyp.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4)穿刺傷害。

rSvANk3O.name: rSvANk3O
rSvANk3O.description: 獨角獸用它的角觸碰另一個生物。目標被魔法回復11 (2d8 + 2)點生命值。此外，這個觸碰將移除目標身上所有的疾病，並中和目標身上所有的毒素。

hzWRkK1f.name: hzWRkK1f
hzWRkK1f.description: 獨角獸用魔法將自己和最多三個距離它5呎內的自願生物，連同任何它們所穿戴或攜帶的裝備一起傳送到一處獨角獸所熟悉的，最多1哩遠的地點。

C4W2teyx.name: 變形者
C4W2teyx.description: 若吸血鬼不處於日光照射或流水中，它就可以使用它的動作以變形成一個微型的蝙蝠、一團中型的迷霧，或變回它的真實型態。

dkAxEC7u.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
dkAxEC7u.description: 若吸血鬼在一次豁免檢定中失敗，它可以選擇改為使其成功。

nt12w9pM.name: 霧遁
nt12w9pM.description: 當吸血鬼的生命值在它棲所以外的場所被歸零，則只要它不處於日光照射或流水中，吸血鬼就可以轉變為一團迷霧（如變形者特性所述）而非陷入昏迷。若它無法變形，則它將被摧毀。

R8wE3XLx.name: 再生
R8wE3XLx.description: 若吸血鬼在它的回合開始時擁有至少1點生命值且不處於日光照射或流水中，則它將回復20點生命值。若吸血鬼受到光耀傷害或來自聖水的傷害，則這個特性在吸血鬼的下個回合開始時並不會發揮作用。

7ACQI4MB.name: 蛛行
7ACQI4MB.description: 吸血鬼可以爬越困難表面，包括倒吊在天花板上，而無須進行屬性檢定。

PkILy8Yd.name: PkILy8Yd

value.value: 多重攻擊 (限定吸血鬼型態)

PkILy8Yd.description: 吸血鬼進行二次攻擊，但其中只有一次可以是啃咬攻擊。

e42O3BAr.name: e42O3BAr

value.value: 徒手打擊 (限定吸血鬼型態)
1d8 + 4 @鈍擊 @吸血鬼也可以選擇不造成

e42O3BAr.description: mw 命中9，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4)鈍擊傷害。吸血鬼也可以選擇不造成傷害，而是擒抱該目標(逃脫DC 18)。

ZoUf8HcJ.name: ZoUf8HcJ

value.value: 啃咬 (限定蝙蝠或吸血鬼型態)
1d6 + 4+3d6 @穿刺 @死靈 @目標的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受死靈

ZoUf8HcJ.description: mw 命中9，觸及5呎，單一自願生物，或一個被擒於該吸血鬼、或陷入無力、或束縛狀態的生物。on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4)穿刺傷害加 10 (3d6)死靈傷害。目標的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受死靈傷害的數值，且吸血鬼回復等同該數值的生命值。這個減損持續直到目標完成一次長休。若目標因為這個效果而導致生命值最大值歸零，則目標死亡。一個被這個方式殺死並被葬入土中的類人生物，將在之後的夜晚在吸血鬼的控制下做為吸血鬼眷族復活。

BuSTFwEy.name: BuSTFwEy
BuSTFwEy.description: 吸血鬼選擇一個距離它30呎內且它所能看見的類人生物做為目標。若目標可以看見吸血鬼，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 17的睿知豁免以對抗這個魔法，否則將被吸血鬼給魅惑。被魅惑的生物將視吸血鬼為一名可信任的朋友，且需要被順從和保護。儘管目標並不處於吸血鬼的控制下，它仍然會盡可能以對其有利的方式執行吸血鬼的要求或行動，並會自願做為吸血鬼啃咬攻擊的目標。

2itMmPU1.name: 2itMmPU1
2itMmPU1.description: 只要太陽尚未升起，吸血鬼就可以用魔法喚來2d4群蝙蝠群或老鼠群。當在戶外時，吸血鬼可以改為喚來3d6個狼。被呼喚的生物將在1d4輪後抵達，做為吸血鬼的盟友行動並服從其口頭命令。這些野獸將持續存在長達1小時，直到吸血鬼死亡、或直到吸血鬼以一個附贈動作將牠們遣散。

t1SAywbn.name: 再生
t1SAywbn.description: 若吸血鬼眷族在它的回合開始時擁有至少1點生命值且不處於日光照射或流水中，則它將回復10點生命值。若吸血鬼眷族受到光耀傷害或來自聖水的傷害，則這個特性在吸血鬼眷族的下個回合開始時並不會發揮作用

eF2kUQ3P.name: 蛛行
eF2kUQ3P.description: 吸血鬼眷族可以爬越困難表面，包括倒吊在天花板上，而無須進行屬性檢定。

8ZWpYvc0.name: 吸血鬼弱點
8ZWpYvc0.description: 吸血鬼眷族具有以下缺陷：

On9NdLeT.name: On9NdLeT
On9NdLeT.description: 吸血鬼眷族進行二次攻擊，但其中只有一次可以是啃咬攻擊。

0iF4r2sH.name: 0iF4r2sH

value.value: 1d6 + 3+2d6 @穿刺 @死靈 @目標的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受死靈

0iF4r2sH.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一自願生物，或一個被擒於該吸血鬼眷族、或陷入無力、或束縛狀態的生物。on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)穿刺傷害加 7 (2d6)死靈傷害。目標的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受死靈傷害的數值，且該吸血鬼眷族回復等同該數值的生命值。這個減損持續直到目標完成一次長休。若目標因為這個效果而導致生命值最大值歸零，則目標死亡。

value.value: 2d4 + 3 @劈砍 @吸血鬼眷族也可以選擇不造成

z5L73SmV.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 8 (2d4 + 3)劈砍傷害。吸血鬼眷族也可以選擇不造成傷害，而是擒抱該目標(逃脫DC 13)。

VampireSpellcaster.name: 吸血鬼施法者 Vampire Spellcaster

PzAxIZmh.description: 若吸血鬼不處於日光照射或流水中，它就可以使用它的動作以變形成一個微型的蝙蝠、一團中型的迷霧，或變回它的真實型態。

pTlWegoE.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
pTlWegoE.description: 若吸血鬼在一次豁免檢定中失敗，它可以選擇改為使其成功。

sDwQxIoS.name: 擬形
sDwQxIoS.description: 當枯藤怪保持不動，它看起來就跟糾纏成團的藤蔓一模一樣。

ieuZfPvd.name: 盲視
ieuZfPvd.value: 60呎（超過半徑範圍則視作目盲）

3Dab2M5s.name: 3Dab2M5s
3Dab2M5s.description: mw 命中4，觸及10呎，單一目標。on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2)鈍擊傷害，且體型為大型或更小的目標被擒(逃脫DC 12)。直到擒抱結束前，該目標被束縛，且枯藤怪不能絞纏另一個目標。

IlX0MoAE.name: IlX0MoAE
IlX0MoAE.description: 攫抓鬚根和藤蔓在以枯藤怪為中心的15呎半徑範圍內蔓生而出，並在1分鐘後枯萎死去。在持續期間，這個區域對非植物生物而言為困難地形。此外，在植被出現時處於範圍內，每個由枯藤怪所選擇的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 12的力量豁免，否則被束縛。一個生物可以使用它的動作以進行一次DC 12的力量檢定，若成功則將自己或觸及範圍內另一個被糾纏的生物給釋放。

35H7p8uM.name: 擬形
35H7p8uM.description: 當紫蕈保持不動，它看起來就跟普通的蕈類一模一樣。

eEnTRkZO.name: 盲視

omPO3g1W.name: omPO3g1W
omPO3g1W.description: 紫蕈進行1d4次腐壞之觸攻擊。

e5iD6qEx.name: e5iD6qEx
e5iD6qEx.description: mw 命中2，觸及10呎，單一生物。on hit: 4 (1d8)死靈傷害。

mdRoLENk.name: mdRoLENk
mdRoLENk.description: 弗洛魔進行二次攻擊：一次喙啄，一次禽爪。

DF3wUd2p.name: DF3wUd2p
DF3wUd2p.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3)穿刺傷害。

vHFsmfQ0.name: vHFsmfQ0
vHFsmfQ0.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3)劈砍傷害。

ybUlMDNI.name: ybUlMDNI
ybUlMDNI.description: 一團15呎半徑的劇毒孢子雲從弗洛魔身上擴散。這團孢子雲會繞過轉角。每個在範圍內的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 14的體質豁免，否則陷入中毒狀態。當因此而中毒時，目標將在它的每個回合開始時受到5 (1d10)毒素傷害。目標可以在它的每個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定，豁免成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。將整瓶的聖水(扁瓶裝)|phb|聖水潑在目標上也能結束這個效果對它的影響。

mMj6U7aC.name: mMj6U7aC
mMj6U7aC.description: 弗洛魔發出一陣恐怖的尖嘯。每個距離它20呎內，可以聽見它，且不是惡魔的生物必須成功通過一次DC 14的體質豁免，否則被震懾直到弗洛魔的下個回合結束。

ztQumAgc.name: 敏銳視覺和嗅覺
ztQumAgc.description: 禿鷲在依賴視覺和嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

LkYCNplM.name: 群體戰術
LkYCNplM.description: 若禿鷲有至少一個隊友距離目標生物5呎內且該隊友並未無力，則禿鷲在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

Q4ZV6D29.name: Q4ZV6D29
Q4ZV6D29.description: mw 命中2，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 2 (1d4)穿刺傷害。

PbLQmOSf.name: 踐踏衝鋒
PbLQmOSf.description: 若戰馬向著一個生物直線移動至少20呎並接著在同回合以一次蹄擊攻擊命中它，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 14的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。若目標伏地，則戰馬能夠以一次附贈動作再對它進行一次蹄擊攻擊。

AM3nsrjG.name: AM3nsrjG
AM3nsrjG.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4)鈍擊傷害。

i3DGV5Y7.name: i3DGV5Y7
i3DGV5Y7.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4)鈍擊傷害。

P3NiZ1wW.name: 流水形體
P3NiZ1wW.description: 水元素可以進入一個敵對生物所在的空間並在該處停下。它也可以移動穿越最窄1吋的狹窄空間而不用擠縮身體。

dJCWlfym.name: 凍結
dJCWlfym.description: 若水元素受到寒冰傷害，它身體的一部分將被凍結；直到它的下個回合結束前，它的移動速度降低20呎。

TKIJdnCD.name: TKIJdnCD
TKIJdnCD.description: 水元素進行二次猛擊攻擊。

5InsjQEF.name: 5InsjQEF
5InsjQEF.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4)鈍擊傷害。

9I0PXONT.name: 9I0PXONT
9I0PXONT.description: 每個在水元素所在空間的生物都必須進行一次DC 15的力量豁免。若豁免失敗，目標將受到13 (2d8 + 4)鈍擊傷害。若它的體型為大型或更小，它也將被擒抱（逃脫DC 14）。直到擒抱結束前，目標被束縛且無法呼吸（除非它能在水下呼吸）。若豁免成功，目標將被推出水元素所在的空間。

Io6FfGch.name: 水中隱形
Io6FfGch.description: 水詭在完全浸入水中時處於隱形狀態。

QTapD6iX.name: 水體聯結
QTapD6iX.description: 若水詭離開它所聯結的水體、或該水體被摧毀，則水詭將會死亡。

nJNFDQUT.name: nJNFDQUT
nJNFDQUT.description: mw 命中5，觸及10呎，單一生物。on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3)鈍擊傷害。若目標為一個體型為中型或更小的生物，則它將被擒(逃脫DC 13)且被向水詭的位置拉近5呎距離。直到擒抱結束前，該目標被束縛，水詭將嘗試將它溺斃，且水詭不能絞纏另一個目標。

0QI5yNPb.name: 敏銳聽覺和嗅覺
0QI5yNPb.description: 鼬鼠在依賴聽覺或嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

o4w71KYE.name: o4w71KYE
o4w71KYE.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 1 穿刺傷害。

0aAXbkLu.name: 變形者
0aAXbkLu.description: 熊人可以使用它的動作以變形成一個大型的半熊類人或一隻大型的熊，或變回它類人生物的真實型態。除了它的體型和AC之外，它在各個型態的數據保持不變。任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備並不會隨著變形發生轉變。它會在死亡時回復它的真實型態。

sdbQmMg7.name: 敏銳嗅覺
sdbQmMg7.description: 熊人在依賴嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

vpV1yOlU.name: vpV1yOlU
vpV1yOlU.description: 在熊型態下，熊人進行二次爪抓攻擊。在類人型態下，它進行二次巨斧攻擊。在半熊人型態下，它可以像熊型態或類人型態一樣進行攻擊。

amWBbE5y.name: amWBbE5y

value.value: 啃咬 (限定熊或半熊人型態)

amWBbE5y.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個類人生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 14的體質豁免，否則將被熊人獸化症給詛咒。

2LmtniTs.name: 2LmtniTs

value.value: 爪抓 (限定熊或半熊人型態)

2LmtniTs.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4)劈砍傷害。

YsVE5hFp.name: YsVE5hFp

value.value: 巨斧 (限定類人或半熊人型態)

YsVE5hFp.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 10 (1d12 + 4)劈砍傷害。

walk.description: (熊或半熊人型態下則為40呎, 攀爬30呎)

qmsdAULk.name: 變形者
qmsdAULk.description: 野豬人可以使用它的動作以變形成一個半野豬類人或一隻野豬，或變回它類人生物的真實型態。除了它的AC之外，它在各個型態的數據保持不變。任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備並不會隨著變形發生轉變。它會在死亡時回復它的真實型態。

EfPvKDF3.name: 衝鋒 (限定野豬或半野豬人型態)
EfPvKDF3.description: 若野豬人向著一個目標直線移動至少15呎並接著在同回合以一次獠牙攻擊命中它，則目標將受到額外的7 (2d6)劈砍傷害。若目標為一個生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 13的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。

Y5Iz8iFW.name: 頑強 (短休或長休之後充能)
Y5Iz8iFW.description: 若野豬人受到14點或更低的傷害而使其生命值歸零，則改為將它的生命值減少至1。

YXRG38gA.name: YXRG38gA

value.value: 多重攻擊 (限定類人或半野豬人型態)

YXRG38gA.description: 野豬人進行二次攻擊，其中只有一次可以是獠牙攻擊。

ftekK8RE.name: ftekK8RE

value.value: 巨鎚 (限定類人或半野豬人型態)

ftekK8RE.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3)鈍擊傷害。

QT8Dlja3.name: QT8Dlja3

value.value: 獠牙 (限定野豬或半野豬人型態)

QT8Dlja3.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3)劈砍傷害。若目標為一個類人生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則將被野豬人獸化症給詛咒。

HiJwQ5hV.name: 變形者
HiJwQ5hV.description: 鼠人可以使用它的動作以變形成一個半鼠類人或一隻巨鼠，或變回它類人生物的真實型態。除了它的體型之外，它在各個型態的數據保持不變。任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備並不會隨著變形發生轉變。它會在死亡時回復它的真實型態。

XnstxBj6.description: rw 命中4，射程30/120呎，單一目標。on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)穿刺傷害。

UzQYcaF2.name: 變形者
UzQYcaF2.description: 虎人可以使用它的動作以變形成一個半虎類人或一隻老虎，或變回它類人生物的真實型態。除了它的體型之外，它在各個型態的數據保持不變。任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備並不會隨著變形發生轉變。它會在死亡時回復它的真實型態。

eGpsbayd.description: 虎人在依賴聽覺和嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

VWz6Qryw.name: 猛撲 (限定虎或半虎人型態)
VWz6Qryw.description: 若虎人向著一個生物直線移動至少15呎並接著在同回合以一次爪抓攻擊命中它，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 14的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地伏地。若目標伏地，則老虎能夠以一次附贈動作對它進行一次啃咬攻擊。

7lfb5GUV.name: 7lfb5GUV

value.value: 多重攻擊 (限定類人或半虎人型態)

7lfb5GUV.description: 在類人型態下，虎人進行二次彎刀攻擊或二次長弓攻擊。在半虎人型態下，它可以像類人型態一樣攻擊或進行二次爪抓攻擊。

VU37SuEs.name: VU37SuEs

value.value: 啃咬 (限定虎或半虎人型態)

VU37SuEs.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個類人生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 13的體質豁免，否則將被虎人獸化症給詛咒。

c8fCSRiW.name: c8fCSRiW

c8fCSRiW.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)劈砍傷害。

FLH1T8yP.name: FLH1T8yP

value.value: 彎刀 (限定類人或半虎人型態)

FLH1T8yP.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)劈砍傷害。

rdwKZc01.name: rdwKZc01

value.value: 長弓 (限定類人或半虎人型態)

rdwKZc01.description: rw 命中4，射程150/600呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2)穿刺傷害。

ED8obQdG.name: 變形者
ED8obQdG.description: 狼人可以使用它的動作以變形成一個半狼類人或一隻狼，或變回它類人生物的真實型態。除了它的AC之外，它在各個型態的數據保持不變。任何它所穿戴或攜帶的裝備並不會隨著變形發生轉變。它會在死亡時回復它的真實型態。

sE9HjzmA.name: 敏銳聽覺和嗅覺
sE9HjzmA.description: 狼人在依賴聽覺和嗅覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有優勢。

9OL1ZF2E.name: 9OL1ZF2E

value.value: 多重攻擊 (限定類人或半狼人型態)

9OL1ZF2E.description: 狼人進行二次攻擊：二次矛攻擊（類人型態）、或一次啃咬，一次爪抓（半狼人型態）。

P6shIFKZ.name: P6shIFKZ

value.value: 啃咬 (限定狼或半狼人型態)

P6shIFKZ.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2)穿刺傷害。若目標為一個類人生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則將被狼人獸化症給詛咒。

Pv6wsMAD.name: Pv6wsMAD
Pv6wsMAD.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2)劈砍傷害。

7E0SNVgY.name: 7E0SNVgY
7E0SNVgY.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或 射程20/60呎，單一生物。on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)穿刺傷害，或若雙手使用以進行一次近戰攻擊時則造成 6 (1d8 + 2)穿刺傷害。

WhiteDragonWyrmling.name: 白龍幼龍 White Dragon Wyrmling

qDMIX1Gb.name: qDMIX1Gb
qDMIX1Gb.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2)穿刺傷害加 2 (1d4)寒冰傷害。

3zrhqtKv.name: 3zrhqtKv

value.value: 5d8 @寒冰 @豁免成功則只受到一半的

3zrhqtKv.description: 白龍吐出一道15呎錐形的冰雪爆風。每個在吐息範圍內的生物都必須進行一次DC 12的體質豁免，豁免失敗則受到22 (5d8)寒冰傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半的傷害。

TQzSGOAH.name: 日光敏感
TQzSGOAH.description: 當處於日光照耀下時，屍妖在攻擊檢定，以及依賴視覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有劣勢。

GLNVOrem.name: GLNVOrem
GLNVOrem.description: 屍妖進行二次長劍攻擊或二次長弓攻擊。它可以使用生命吸取以取代其中一次長劍攻擊。

KYuzOpHT.name: KYuzOpHT

value.value: 1d6 + 2 @死靈 @否則它的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受

KYuzOpHT.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)死靈傷害。目標必須成功通過一次DC 13的體質豁免，否則它的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受傷害的數值。這個減損持續直到目標完成一次長休。若目標因為這個效果而導致生命值最大值歸零，則目標死亡。

ulK7cTx0.name: ulK7cTx0
ulK7cTx0.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2)劈砍傷害，或若以雙手使用則造成 7 (1d10 + 2)劈砍傷害。

jBtydrx4.name: jBtydrx4
jBtydrx4.description: rw 命中4，射程150/600呎，單一目標。on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2)穿刺傷害。

tq9FTzgu.name: 攝食生命
tq9FTzgu.description: 以一個附贈動作，鬼火可以選擇一個距離它5呎內，生命值為0但仍然活著的生物做為目標。目標必須成功通過一次DC 10的體質豁免以對抗此魔法，否則將立即死亡。若目標死亡，鬼火將回復10 (3d6)點生命值。

WGP87uxE.name: 轉瞬即逝
WGP87uxE.description: 鬼火無法穿戴或攜帶任何事物。

4FA5ejPL.name: 虛體移動
4FA5ejPL.description: 鬼火可以把其它生物和物體視作困難地形移動穿過它們。若它在一個物體內結束它的回合，則它將受到5 (1d10)力場傷害。

jrVHta5Q.name: 多變照明
jrVHta5Q.description: 鬼火會散發出5呎到20呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸等同所選半徑距離的微光光照。鬼火能夠以一個附贈動作改變這個照明半徑。

E8WSrBfl.name: E8WSrBfl
E8WSrBfl.description: ms 命中4，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 9 (2d8)閃電傷害。

ScC5ouYj.name: ScC5ouYj
ScC5ouYj.description: 鬼火和它發出的光照以魔法變得隱形，直到它攻擊、使用它的攝食生命、或它的專注被打斷（如同專注於法術）。

WDrlgPfa.name: 日光敏感
WDrlgPfa.description: 當處於日光照耀下時，狗頭人在攻擊檢定，以及依賴視覺的睿知（感知）檢定中具有劣勢。

4zDjpcve.name: 群體戰術
4zDjpcve.description: 若狗頭人有至少一個隊友距離目標生物5呎內且該隊友並未無力，則狗頭人在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

qinVmgp0.description: 縛靈可以把其它生物和物體視作困難地形移動穿過它們。若它在一個物體內結束它的回合，則它將受到5 (1d10)力場傷害。

UjY36iNp.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一生物。on hit: 21 (4d8 + 3)死靈傷害。目標必須成功通過一次DC 14的體質豁免，否則它的生命值最大值將減少等同於所受傷害的數值。這個減損持續直到該生物完成一次長休。若目標因為這個效果而導致生命值最大值歸零，則目標死亡。

TIAoQvs2.description: 縛靈選擇一個距離它10呎內，一個因暴力而死，且死亡時間不超過1分鐘的類人生物做為目標。目標的靈魂將做為一個幽靈被喚起，出現在它屍體所在的空間或最近一處未被佔據空間。這個幽靈處於縛靈的控制之下。縛靈同時最多只能控制不超過七個幽靈。

es9ZjmXG.description: 耶提選擇一個距離它30呎內且它所能看見的生物做為目標。若目標可以看見耶提，則目標必須成功通過一次DC 13的體質豁免以對抗此魔法，否則將受到10 (3d6)寒冰傷害，且除非目標免疫於寒冰傷害，否則它接著將陷入麻痺狀態長達1分鐘。目標可以在它的每個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定，豁免成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。若目標豁免成功，或這個效果對它的影響結束，則該目標將在1小時內免疫於所有耶提（但不包括巨惡耶提）的寒顫凝視。

H8rwQpDz.name: 不死韌性
H8rwQpDz.description: 若殭屍因受到傷害而使生命值歸零，除非該傷害為光耀傷害或來自重擊，否則它必須進行一次DC 5+所受傷害值的體質豁免。若豁免成功，則改為將它的生命值減少至1。

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The kruthik has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Tunneler.name: Tunneler
Tunneler.description: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The kruthik makes two stab attacks or two spike attacks.

Stab.name: Stab
Stab.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

Spike.name: Spike
Spike.description: rw 5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

SulfurousImpersonation.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
SulfurousImpersonation.description: As a bonus action, the oblex can extrude a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. For all practical purposes, the simulacrum is the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The slimy tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex's main body and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The oblex makes one pseudopod attack and uses Eat Memories.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

EatMemories.name: EatMemories
EatMemories.description: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, oozes, plants, and undead succeed on the save automatically.

AirElementalMyrmidon.name: 氣元素追隨者 Air Elemental Myrmidon

vT5B69S1.name: 魔法武器
vT5B69S1.description: 追隨者的武器攻擊視作魔法攻擊。

4AFWCmMQ.name: 4AFWCmMQ
4AFWCmMQ.description: 追隨者進行三次連枷攻擊。

nsGqCd8e.name: nsGqCd8e
nsGqCd8e.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) 鈍擊傷害。

uHAaxVTP.name: uHAaxVTP
uHAaxVTP.description: 追隨者進行一次連枷攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則它將額外造成 18 (4d8)閃電傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次DC 14的體質豁免，否則將被震懾直到該追隨者的下個回合結束。

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The alkilith can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the alkilith is motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary slime or fungus.

FomentMadness.name: Foment Madness
FomentMadness.description: Any creature that isn't a demon that starts its turn within 30 feet of the alkilith must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, or it hears a faint buzzing in its head for a moment and has disadvantage on its next attack roll, saving throw, or ability check.

2SdRcKyU.name: 魔法抗性
2SdRcKyU.description: The alkilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The alkilith makes three tentacle attacks.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The allip can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

MaddeningTouch.name: MaddeningTouch
MaddeningTouch.description: ms 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.

WhispersofMadness.name: WhispersofMadness
WhispersofMadness.description: The allip chooses up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, or it takes 7 (1d8 + 3) psychic damage and must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against one creature of the allip's choice that the allip can see. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.

HowlingBabble{@recharge}.name: HowlingBabble{@recharge}
HowlingBabble{@recharge}.description: Each creature within 30 feet of the allip that can hear it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage, and it is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't stunned. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.

Devil'sSight.name: Devil's Sight
Devil'sSight.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the amnizu's darkvision.

MCQxBklf.name: 魔法抗性
MCQxBklf.description: The amnizu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The amnizu uses Poison Mind. It also makes two attacks: one with its whip and one with its Disruptive Touch.

TaskmasterWhip.name: TaskmasterWhip
TaskmasterWhip.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 33 (6d10) force damage.

DisruptiveTouch.name: DisruptiveTouch
DisruptiveTouch.description: ms 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 44 (8d10) necrotic damage.

PoisonMind.name: PoisonMind
PoisonMind.description: The amnizu targets one or two creatures that it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is blinded until the start of the amnizu's next turn.

Forgetfulness{@recharge}.name: Forgetfulness{@recharge}
Forgetfulness{@recharge}.description: The amnizu targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. That creature must make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw and on a failure the target is stunned for 1 minute. A stunned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target remains stunned for the full minute, it forgets everything it sensed, experienced, and learned during the last 5 hours.

8j0vuQIq.name: 魔法抗性
8j0vuQIq.description: The armanite has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The armanite's weapon attacks are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The armanite makes three attacks: one with its hooves, one with its claws, and one with its serrated tail.

Hooves.name: Hooves
Hooves.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

SerratedTail.name: SerratedTail
SerratedTail.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

LightningLance{@recharge5}.name: LightningLance{@recharge5}
LightningLance{@recharge5}.description: The armanite looses a bolt of lightning in a line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

AntimagicCone.name: Antimagic Cone
AntimagicCone.description: The astral dreadnought's opened eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreadnought decides which way the cone faces. The cone doesn't function while the dreadnought's eye is closed or while the dreadnought is blinded.

AstralEntity.name: Astral Entity
AstralEntity.description: The astral dreadnought can't leave the Astral Plane, nor can it be banished or otherwise transported out of the Astral Plane.

DemiplanarDonjon.name: Demiplanar Donjon
DemiplanarDonjon.description: Any creature or object that the astral dreadnought swallows is transported to a demiplane that can be entered by no other means except a wish spell or this creature's Donjon Visit ability. A creature can leave the demiplane only by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the plane shift spell. The demiplane resembles a stone cave roughly 1,000 feet in diameter with a ceiling 100 feet high. Like a stomach, it contains the remains of the dreadnought's past meals.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the astral dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: An astral dreadnought's weapon attacks are magical.

SeverSilverCord.name: Sever Silver Cord
SeverSilverCord.description: If the astral dreadnought scores a critical hit against a creature traveling through the Astral Plane by means of the astral projection spell, the dreadnought can cut the target's silver cord instead of dealing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The astral dreadnought makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (5d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a creature of Huge size or smaller and this damage reduces it to 0 hit points or it is incapacitated, the astral dreadnought swallows it. The swallowed target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in an unoccupied space on the floor of the astral dreadnought's Demiplanar Donjon.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) slashing damage.

EnchantingPresence.name: Enchanting Presence
EnchantingPresence.description: Any non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the eladrin must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any eladrin's Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.

FeyStep{@recharge4}.name: Fey Step {@recharge 4}
FeyStep{@recharge4}.description: As a bonus action, the eladrin can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

MbWfeZ83.name: 魔法抗性
MbWfeZ83.description: The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage if used with two hands.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

Dreadful.name: Dreadful
Dreadful.description: Bael can use a bonus action to appear dreadful until the start of his next turn. Each creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 10 feet of Bael must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the creature's next turn.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Bael fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

fNiFCJLn.name: 魔法抗性
fNiFCJLn.description: Bael has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: Bael's weapon attacks are magical.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Bael regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Bael dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Bael makes two melee attacks.

HellishMorningstar.name: HellishMorningstar
HellishMorningstar.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

InfernalCommand.name: InfernalCommand
InfernalCommand.description: Each ally of Bael's within 60 feet of him can't be charmed or frightened until the end of his next turn.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Bael magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the balhannoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The balhannoth makes a bite attack and up to two tentacle attacks, or it makes up to four tentacle attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the balhannoth. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the balhannoth can't use this tentacle against other targets. The balhannoth has four tentacles.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If Baphomet moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 22 (4d10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

LabyrinthineRecall.name: Labyrinthine Recall
LabyrinthineRecall.description: Baphomet can perfectly recall any path he has traveled, and he is immune to the maze spell.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Baphomet fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

tVMJWlC7.name: 魔法抗性
tVMJWlC7.description: Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Reckless.name: Reckless
Reckless.description: At the start of his turn, Baphomet can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Baphomet makes three attacks: one with Heartcleaver, one with his bite, and one with his gore attack.

Heartcleaver.name: Heartcleaver
Heartcleaver.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage.

FrightfulPresence.name: FrightfulPresence
FrightfulPresence.description: Each creature of Baphomet's choice within 120 feet of him and aware of him must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. These later saves have disadvantage if Baphomet is within line of sight of the creature.

SpectralDuplicate(RechargesafteraShortor.name: Spectral Duplicate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
SpectralDuplicate(RechargesafteraShortor.description: As a bonus action, the berbalang creates one spectral duplicate of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. While the duplicate exists, the berbalang is unconscious. A berbalang can have only one duplicate at a time. The duplicate disappears when it or the berbalang drops to 0 hit points or when the berbalang dismisses it (no action required).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The berbalang makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

ShadowStep.description: While in dim light or darkness, the drow can teleport as a bonus action up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is also in dim light or darkness. It then has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The drow makes two attacks with its shadow sword. If either attack hits and the target is within 10 feet of a 5-foot cube of darkness created by the shadow sword on a previous turn, the drow can dismiss that darkness and cause the target to take 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The drow can dismiss darkness in this way no more than once per turn.

ShadowSword.name: ShadowSword
ShadowSword.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and 10 (3d6) poison damage. The drow can then fill an unoccupied 5-foot cube within 5 feet of the target with magical darkness, which remains for 1 minute.

HandCrossbow.name: HandCrossbow
HandCrossbow.description: rw 9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target regains consciousness if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it.

O92vXlyG.name: 魔法抗性
O92vXlyG.description: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

PsychicEngine.name: Psychic Engine
PsychicEngine.description: When the duergar despot suffers a critical hit or is reduced to 0 hit points, psychic energy erupts from its frame to deal 14 (4d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the duergar despot has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The despot makes two iron fist attacks and two stomping foot attacks. It can replace up to four of these attacks with uses of its Flame Jet.

IronFist.name: IronFist
IronFist.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must make a successful DC 17 Strength saving throw or be thrown up to 30 feet away in a straight line. The target is knocked prone and then takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

StompingFoot.name: StompingFoot
StompingFoot.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage to a prone target.

FlameJet.name: FlameJet
FlameJet.description: The duergar spews flames in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

EngineofPain.name: Engine of Pain
EngineofPain.description: Once per turn, a creature that attacks the hammerer can target the duergar trapped in it. The attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 5 (1d10) damage to the hammerer, and the hammerer can respond by using its Multiattack with its reaction.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The hammerer deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hammerer makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its hammer.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

Hammer.name: Hammer
Hammer.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

Mounted.name: Mounted
Mounted.description: The vicious kavalrachni are the duergar cavalry of Gracklstugh, riding giant tarantulas known as steeders (see the female steeder stat block)

CavalryTraining.name: Cavalry Training
CavalryTraining.description: When the duergar hits a target with a melee attack while mounted on a female steeder, the steeder can make a melee attack against the same target as a reaction.

DuergarResilience.name: Duergar Resilience

If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

Javelin.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw, or the duergar causes it to use its reaction either to make one weapon attack against another creature the duergar can see or to move up to 10 feet in a direction of the duergar's choice. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The dybbuk can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

sdiBA5Xe.name: 魔法抗性
sdiBA5Xe.description: The dybbuk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

ViolateCorpse.name: Violate Corpse
ViolateCorpse.description: The dybbuk can use a bonus action while it is possessing a corpse to make it do something unnatural, such as vomit blood, twist its head all the way around, or cause a quadruped to move as a biped. Any beast or humanoid that sees this behavior must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against this ability is immune to Violate Corpse for 24 hours.

Tendril.name: Tendril
Tendril.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its hit point maximum is also reduced by 3 (1d6). This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

PossessCorpse{@recharge}.name: PossessCorpse{@recharge}
PossessCorpse{@recharge}.description: The dybbuk disappears into an intact corpse it can see within 5 feet of it. The corpse must be Large or smaller and be that of a beast or a humanoid. The dybbuk is now effectively the possessed creature. Its type becomes undead, though it now looks alive, and it gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the corpse's hit point maximum in life.

Smb6W9wG.description: 追隨者進行二次巨鎚攻擊。

lEusBLeR.name: lEusBLeR
lEusBLeR.description: 追隨者進行一次巨鎚攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則它將額外造成 16 (3d10)雷鳴傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次DC 14的力量豁免，否則將被擊倒伏地。

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The eidolon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object other than a sacred statue.

SacredAnimation{@recharge5}.name: Sacred Animation {@recharge 5}
SacredAnimation{@recharge5}.description: When the eidolon moves into a space occupied by a sacred statue, the eidolon can disappear, causing the statue to become a creature under the eidolon's control. The eidolon uses the sacred statue|mtf's statistics in place of its own.

TurnResistance.name: Turn Resistance
TurnResistance.description: The eidolon has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

DivineDread.name: DivineDread
DivineDread.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the eidolon that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, the creature must take the Dash action and move away from the eidolon by the safest available route at the start of each of its turns, unless there is nowhere for it to move, in which case the creature also becomes stunned until it can move again. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to any eidolon's Divine Dread for the next 24 hours.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

SulfurousImpersonation.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
SulfurousImpersonation.description: As a bonus action, the oblex can extrude a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 2d6 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. For all practical purposes, the simulacrum is the oblex, meaning the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The slimy tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex's main body and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The elder oblex makes two pseudopod attacks and uses Eat Memories.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

EatMemories.name: EatMemories
EatMemories.description: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, oozes, plants, and undead succeed on the save automatically.

AirForm.name: Air Form
AirForm.description: The tempest can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The tempest doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the tempest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

LivingStorm.name: Living Storm
LivingStorm.description: The tempest is always at the center of a storm 1d6 + 4 miles in diameter. Heavy precipitation in the form of either rain or snow falls there, causing the area to be lightly obscured. Heavy rain also extinguishes open flames and imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tempest makes two attacks with its thunderous slam.

ThunderousSlam.name: ThunderousSlam
ThunderousSlam.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) thunder damage.

If a target's saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

SpiderClimb.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Leap.name: Leap
Leap.description: The steeder can expend all its movement on its turn to jump up to 90 feet vertically or horizontally, provided that is speed is at least 30 feet.

Oar.name: Oar

MagicWeapons.description: Moloch's weapon attacks are magical.

Regeneration.description: Moloch regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Moloch dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

Many-TailedWhip.name: Many-TailedWhip
Many-TailedWhip.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d4 + 8) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet in a straight line toward Moloch.

BreathofDespair{@recharge5}.name: BreathofDespair{@recharge5}
BreathofDespair{@recharge5}.description: Moloch exhales in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, drop whatever it is holding, and become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from Moloch by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move, in which case it needn't take the Dash action. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to Moloch, the creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Moloch magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the molydeus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

EAZ1mO5J.name: 魔法抗性
EAZ1mO5J.description: The molydeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The molydeus's weapon attacks are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The molydeus makes three attacks: one with its weapon, one with its wolf bite, and one with its snakebite.

DemonicWeapon.name: DemonicWeapon
DemonicWeapon.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) slashing damage. If the target has at least one head and the molydeus rolled a 20 on the attack roll, the target is decapitated and dies if it can't survive without that head. A target is immune to this effect if it takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger. Such a creature takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

WolfBite.name: WolfBite
WolfBite.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage.

Snakebite.name: Snakebite
Snakebite.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. on hit: 12 (1d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target transforms into a manes if this reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This transformation can be ended only by a wish spell.

DemonicShadows.name: Demonic Shadows
DemonicShadows.description: The nabassu darkens the area around its body in a 10-foot radius. Nonmagical light can't illuminate this area of dim light.

DevourSoul.name: Devour Soul
DevourSoul.description: A nabassu can eat the soul of a creature it has killed within the last hour, provided that creature is neither a construct nor an undead. The devouring requires the nabassu to be within 5 feet of the corpse for at least 10 minutes, after which it gains a number of Hit Dice (d8s) equal to half the creature's number of Hit Dice. Roll those dice, and increase the nabassu's hit points by the numbers rolled. For every 4 Hit Dice the nabassu gains in this way, its attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage on a hit. The nabassu retains these benefits for 6 days. A creature devoured by a nabassu can be restored to life only by a wish spell.

DKC3kRzJ.name: 魔法抗性
DKC3kRzJ.description: The nabassu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The nabassu's weapon attacks are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The nabassu uses its Soul-Stealing Gaze and makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage.

Soul-StealingGaze.name: Soul-StealingGaze
Soul-StealingGaze.description: The nabassu targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the nabassu and isn't a construct or an undead, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or reduce its hit point maximum by 13 (2d12) damage and give the nabassu an equal number of temporary hit points. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0, and if the target is a humanoid, it immediately rises as a ghoul under the nabassu's control.

Corruption.name: Corruption
Corruption.description: As a bonus action, the nagpa targets one creature it can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. An evil creature makes the save with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the nagpa until the start of the nagpa's next turn. On a successful save, the target becomes immune to the nagpa's Corruption for the next 24 hours.

Paralysis{@recharge}.name: Paralysis {@recharge}
Paralysis{@recharge}.description: As a bonus action, the nagpa forces each creature within 30 feet of it to succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Undead and constructs are immune to this effect.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

DiabolicalSense.name: Diabolical Sense
DiabolicalSense.description: The narzugon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive good-aligned creatures.

InfernalTack.name: Infernal Tack
InfernalTack.description: The narzugon wears spurs that are part of infernal tack, which allow it to summon its nightmare companion.

Multiattack.description: The narzugon uses its Infernal Command or Terrifying Command. It also makes three hellfire lance attacks.

HellfireLance.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) fire damage. If this damage kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours.

InfernalCommand.name: InfernalCommand
InfernalCommand.description: Each ally of the narzugon within 60 feet of it can't be charmed or frightened until the end of the narzugon's next turn.

TerrifyingCommand.name: TerrifyingCommand
TerrifyingCommand.description: Each creature that isn't a fiend within 60 feet of the narzugon that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute.

Healing(1/Day).name: Healing(1/Day)
Healing(1/Day).description: The narzugon, or one creature it touches, regains up to 100 hit points.

AnnihilatingAura.name: Annihilating Aura
AnnihilatingAura.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwalker must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and grant the nightwalker advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of the creature's next turn. Undead are immune to this aura.

LifeEater.name: Life Eater
LifeEater.description: A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the nightwalker dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The nightwalker uses Enervating Focus twice, or it uses Enervating Focus and Finger of Doom, if available.

EnervatingFocus.name: EnervatingFocus
EnervatingFocus.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

FingerofDoom{@recharge}.name: FingerofDoom{@recharge}
FingerofDoom{@recharge}.description: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and become frightened until the end of the nightwalker's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature is also paralyzed. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the nightwalker's Finger of Doom for the next 24 hours.

CloudofVermin.name: Cloud of Vermin
CloudofVermin.description: Any creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nupperibo must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. A creature within the areas of two or more nupperibos makes the saving throw with disadvantage. On a failure, the creature takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

Hunger-Driven.name: Hunger-Driven
Hunger-Driven.description: In the Nine Hells, the nupperibos can flawlessly track any creature that has taken damage from any nupperibo's Cloud of Vermin within the previous 24 hours.

Harpoon.name: Harpoon
Harpoon.description: rw 7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappled in this way, a creature's speed isn't reduced, but it can move only in directions that bring it closer to the oaken bolter. A creature takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes from the grapple or if it tries and fails. As a bonus action, the oaken bolter can pull a creature grappled by it 20 feet closer. The oaken bolter can grapple only one creature at a time.

ExplosiveBolt{@recharge5}.name: ExplosiveBolt{@recharge5}
ExplosiveBolt{@recharge5}.description: The oaken bolter launches an explosive charge at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The ogre deals double damage to objects and structures.

Bash.name: Bash
Bash.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the ogre can push the target 5 feet away if the target is Huge or smaller.

BlockthePath.name: BlockthePath
BlockthePath.description: Until the start of the ogre's next turn, attack rolls against the ogre have disadvantage, it has advantage on the attack roll it makes for an opportunity attack, and that attack deals an extra 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage on a hit. Also, each enemy that tries to move out of the ogre's reach without teleporting must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of the ogre's next turn.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Fist.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

ChainSweep.name: ChainSweep
ChainSweep.description: The ogre swings its chain, and every creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

ChainSmash{@recharge}.name: ChainSmash{@recharge}
ChainSmash{@recharge}.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure the target is unconscious for 1 minute. The unconscious target repeats the saving throw if it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Howdah.name: Howdah
Howdah.description: The ogre carries a compact fort on its back. Up to four Small creatures can ride in the fort without squeezing. To make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet of the ogre, they must use spears or weapons with reach. Creatures in the fort have three-quarters cover against attacks and effects from outside it. If the ogre dies, creatures in the fort are placed in unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of the ogre.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

BringerofPlagues{@recharge5}.description: As a bonus action, the oinoloth blights the area within 30 feet of it. The blight lasts for 24 hours. While blighted, all normal plants in the area wither and die, and the number of hit points restored by a spell to a creature in that area is halved.

Multiattack.description: The oinoloth uses its Transfixing Gaze and makes two claw attacks.

CorruptedHealing{@recharge}.name: CorruptedHealing{@recharge}
CorruptedHealing{@recharge}.description: The oinoloth touches one willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains all its hit points. In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 7 (2d6). This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The oinoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

TransfixingGaze.name: TransfixingGaze
TransfixingGaze.description: The oinoloth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed until the end of the oinoloth's next turn. While charmed in this way, the target is restrained. If the target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the oinoloth's gaze for the next 24 hours.

WandofOrcus.name: Wand of Orcus
WandofOrcus.description: The wand has 7 charges, and any of its properties that require a saving throw have a save DC of 18. While holding it, Orcus can use an action to cast 活化死屍, 枯萎術, or speak with dead. Alternatively, he can expend 1 or more of the wand's charges to cast one of the following spells from it: circle of death (1 charge), finger of death (1 charge), or power word kill (2 charges). The wand regains 1d4 + 3 charges daily at dawn.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Orcus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

BV5HZLrK.name: 魔法抗性
BV5HZLrK.description: Orcus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MasterofUndeath.name: Master of Undeath
MasterofUndeath.description: When Orcus casts 活化死屍 or create undead, he chooses the level at which the spell is cast, and the creatures created by the spells remain under his control indefinitely. Additionally, he can cast create undead even when it isn't night.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Orcus makes two Wand of Orcus attacks.

Tail.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

InvisibilityField.name: Invisibility Field
InvisibilityField.description: The orthon can use a bonus action to become invisible. Any equipment the orthon wears or carries is also invisible as long as the equipment is on its person. This invisibility ends immediately after the orthon makes an attack roll or is hit by an attack.

FieryDeathandRebirth.description: When the phoenix dies, it explodes. The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't worn or carried.

FireForm.name: Fire Form
FireForm.description: The phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Any creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. With a touch, the phoenix can also ignite flammable objects that aren't worn or carried (no action required).

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The phoenix doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Multiattack.description: The phoenix makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its fiery talons.

Beak.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

FieryTalons.name: FieryTalons
FieryTalons.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) fire damage.

Devil'sSight.name: Devil's Sight
Devil'sSight.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

Multiattack.description: The abishai can use its Frightful Presence. It also makes three attacks: one with its morningstar, one with its claw, and one with its bite.

Morningstar.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (5d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

FrightfulPresence.name: FrightfulPresence
FrightfulPresence.description: Each creature of the abishai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the abishai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

InciteFanaticism.name: InciteFanaticism
InciteFanaticism.description: The abishai chooses up to four of its allies within 60 feet of it that can see it. For 1 minute, each of those allies makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

PoweroftheDragonQueen.name: PoweroftheDragonQueen
PoweroftheDragonQueen.description: The abishai targets one dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to the abishai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards the abishai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if the abishai or its companions deal damage to the target.

FaultlessTracker.name: Faultless Tracker
FaultlessTracker.description: The retriever is given a quarry by its master. The quarry can be a specific creature or object the master is personally acquainted with, or it can be a general type of creature or object the master has seen before. The retriever knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The retriever can have only one such quarry at a time. The retriever also always knows the location of its master.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The retriever makes two foreleg attacks and uses its force or paralyzing beam once, if available.

Foreleg.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

ForceBeam.description: The retriever targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

ParalyzingBeam{@recharge5}.name: ParalyzingBeam{@recharge5}
ParalyzingBeam{@recharge5}.description: The retriever targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

RancidDegeneration.name: Rancid Degeneration
RancidDegeneration.description: At the end of each of the troll's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, unless the troll has taken acid or fire damage since the end of its last turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

CripplingFear.name: Crippling Fear
CripplingFear.description: When a creature that isn't a demon starts its turn within 30 feet of three or more rutterkins, it must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. The creature has disadvantage on the save if it's within 30 feet of six or more rutterkins. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the Crippling Fear of all rutterkins for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature becomes frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, the creature is restrained. At the end of each of the frightened creature's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned. At the end of each long rest, the poisoned target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points while poisoned in this way, it dies and instantly transforms into a living abyssal wretch. The transformation of the body can be undone only by a wish spell. (See notes)

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the statue remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

GhostlyInhabitant.name: Ghostly Inhabitant
GhostlyInhabitant.description: The eidolon that enters the sacred statue remains inside it until the statue drops to 0 hit points, the eidolon uses a bonus action to move out of the statue, or the eidolon is turned or forced out by an effect such as the dispel evil and good spell. When the eidolon leaves the statue, it appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the statue.

Inert.name: Inert
Inert.description: When not inhabited by an eidolon, the statue is an object.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The statue makes two slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam

FeyAncestry.description: The shadow dancer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

ShadowJump.name: Shadow Jump
ShadowJump.description: As a bonus action, the shadow dancer can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it teleports from and the space it teleports to must be in dim light or darkness. The shadow dancer can use this ability between the weapon attacks of another action it takes.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The shadow dancer makes three spiked chain attacks.

SpikedChain.name: SpikedChain
SpikedChain.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or suffer one additional effect of the shadow dancer's choice:

Contamination.name: Contamination
Contamination.description: The sibriex emits an aura of corruption 30 feet in every direction. Plants that aren't creatures wither in the aura, and the ground in it is difficult terrain for other creatures. Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison damage. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to this sibriex's Contamination for 24 hours.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the sibriex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Chain.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage.

Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.

SquirtBile.name: SquirtBile
SquirtBile.description: The sibriex targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) acid damage.

WarpCreature.name: WarpCreature
WarpCreature.description: The sibriex targets up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature becomes immune to this sibriex's Warp Creature. On a failed save, the target is poisoned, which causes it to also gain 1 level of exhaustion. While poisoned in this way, the target must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. Three successful saves against the poison end it, and ending the poison removes any levels of exhaustion caused by it. Each failed save causes the target to suffer another level of exhaustion. Once the target reaches 6 levels of exhaustion, it dies and instantly transforms into a living abyssal wretch|mtf under the sibriex's control. The transformation of the body can be undone only by a wish spell.

FallibleInvisibility.name: Fallible Invisibility
FallibleInvisibility.description: The skulk is invisible. This invisibility can be circumvented by three things:

Trackless.name: Trackless
Trackless.description: The skulk leaves no tracks to indicate where it has been or where it's headed.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. If the skulk has advantage on the attack roll, the target also takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MasteroftheGrave.name: Master of the Grave
MasteroftheGrave.description: While within 30 feet of the skull lord, any undead ally of the skull lord makes saving throws with advantage, and that ally regains 1d6 hit points whenever it starts its turn there.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If the skull lord is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the skull lord instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The skull lord makes three bone staff attacks.

BoneStaff.name: BoneStaff
BoneStaff.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

FeyAncestry.description: The soul monger has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

e9y3rdgv.description: The soul monger has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SoulThirst.name: Soul Thirst
SoulThirst.description: When the soul monger reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the soul monger can gain temporary hit points equal to half the creature's hit point maximum. While the soul monger has temporary hit points from this ability, it has advantage on attack rolls.

WeightofAges.name: Weight of Ages
WeightofAges.description: Any beast or humanoid, other than a shadar-kai, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the soul monger has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The soul monger makes two phantasmal dagger attacks.

PhantasmalDagger.name: PhantasmalDagger
PhantasmalDagger.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws until the start of the soul monger's next turn.

WaveofWeariness{@recharge4}.name: WaveofWeariness{@recharge4}
WaveofWeariness{@recharge4}.description: The soul monger emits weariness in a 60-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and suffers 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes psychic or force damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

Claws.name: Claws

JoyfulPresence.description: Any non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the eladrin must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is charmed for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any eladrin's Joyful Presence for 24 hours.

fNKElSOi.description: The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.description: The eladrin makes two weapon attacks. The eladrin can cast one spell in place of one of these attacks.
