Longsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage if used with two hands.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

AuraofMadness.description: Creatures within 20 feet of the grue that aren't aberrations have disadvantage on saving throws, as well as on attack rolls against creatures other than a star spawn grue.

PsychicMirror.name: Psychic Mirror
PsychicMirror.description: If the hulk takes psychic damage, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk takes that damage instead; the hulk takes none of the damage. In addition, the hulk's thoughts and location can't be discerned by magic.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hulk makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target also takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the target's next turn.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

ReapingArms{@recharge5}.name: ReapingArms{@recharge5}
ReapingArms{@recharge5}.description: The hulk makes a separate slam attack against each creature within 10 feet of it. Each creature that is hit must also succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

ReturntoWorms.name: Return to Worms
ReturntoWorms.description: When the larva mage is reduced to 0 hit points, it breaks apart into a swarm of insects in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the larva mage reforms from it 24 hours later.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

PlagueofWorms{@recharge}.name: PlagueofWorms{@recharge}
PlagueofWorms{@recharge}.description: Each creature other than a star spawn within 10 feet of the larva mage must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the target takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and is blinded and restrained by masses of swarming worms. The affected creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the larva mage's turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Ambush.name: Ambush
Ambush.description: On the first round of each combat, the mangler has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that hasn't taken a turn yet.

ShadowStealth.name: Shadow Stealth
ShadowStealth.description: While in dim light or darkness, the mangler can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mangler makes two claw attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll has advantage, the target also takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

FlurryofClaws{@recharge4}.name: FlurryofClaws{@recharge4}

Out-of-PhaseMovement.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
Out-of-PhaseMovement.description: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Each creature it moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Multiattack.description: The seer makes two comet staff attacks or uses Psychic Orb twice.

CometStaff.name: CometStaff
CometStaff.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, or 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, if used with two hands, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

PsychicOrb.name: PsychicOrb
PsychicOrb.description: rs 11 to hit, range 120 feet, one target. on hit: 27 (5d10) psychic damage.

CollapseDistance{@recharge}.name: CollapseDistance{@recharge}
CollapseDistance{@recharge}.description: The seer warps space around a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. That creature must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is magically teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the seer can see, and all other creatures within 10 feet of the target's original space each takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The effect ends if the second save is successful; otherwise the target is petrified for 24 hours.

WretchedPackTactics.description: The Wretched has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wretched's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The Wretched otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

c8A62VHI.description: 穴居鯊衛藉著魔法與一只經過訓練的鯊蜥獸聯繫在一起，並將其做為坐騎。當騎乘於它的鯊蜥獸時，穴居鯊衛將共享鯊蜥獸的感官，並可以在其掘地的同時維持騎乘。該鯊蜥獸服從穴居鯊衛的命令。若它的坐騎死亡，穴居鯊衛可以訓練一只新的鯊蜥獸做為其相繫的坐騎，這個過程將花費一個月的時間。

Fk69oKTW.name: Fk69oKTW
Fk69oKTW.description: 穴居鯊衛進行三次近戰攻擊。

alZpEmjG.name: alZpEmjG
alZpEmjG.description: mw,rw 命中6，觸及5呎 或射程20/60呎，單一目標。on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) 穿刺傷害，或若雙手使用以進行一次近戰攻擊時則造成 8 (1d8 + 4) 穿刺傷害。

CrushingWavePriest.name: 粉碎浪潮祭司 Crushing Wave Priest

zcdgvjk9.name: zcdgvjk9
zcdgvjk9.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) 鈍擊傷害。

CrushingWaveReaver.name: 粉碎浪潮掠奪者 Crushing Wave Reaver

YyX0coDx.name: YyX0coDx

value.value: 1d8 + 2+1d10 + 2 @劈砍 @劈砍 @則掠奪者將對其額外造成一顆這把劍的傷害骰的

YyX0coDx.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) 劈砍傷害，或若以雙手使用時則造成 7 (1d10 + 2) 劈砍傷害。若目標沒有穿戴護甲，則掠奪者將對其額外造成一顆這把劍的傷害骰的傷害。

MPWDeQC2.name: MPWDeQC2
MPWDeQC2.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或 射程30/120呎, 單一目標。on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

DarkTideKnight.name: 暗潮騎士 Dark Tide Knight

lUWnKuym.name: 聯結坐騎
lUWnKuym.description: 暗潮騎士藉著魔法與一個具有天生游泳速度，且受過訓練的野獸聯繫在一起，並將其做為自己的坐騎。當騎乘於該野獸時，暗潮騎士將共享該野獸的感官，且獲得在水下呼吸的能力。這個被聯繫的坐騎服從暗潮騎士的命令。若它的坐騎死亡，暗潮騎士可以訓練一只新的野獸做為其相繫的坐騎，這個過程將花費一個月的時間。

toqIEW0r.name: 偷襲
toqIEW0r.description: 當暗潮騎士以武器攻擊命中一個目標時，若該攻擊檢定具有優勢，或者該攻擊檢定沒有劣勢且暗潮騎士有一個未無力的隊友距離目標5呎內，則暗潮騎士造成額外的7 (2d6)傷害。

0WwjoAi7.name: 0WwjoAi7
0WwjoAi7.description: 暗潮騎士進行二次短劍攻擊。

7XaVzckm.name: 7XaVzckm
7XaVzckm.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

Lance.name: Lance
Lance.description: mw 命中5，觸及10呎，單一目標。 on hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

N7ioD8l4.name: 動作如潮 (短休或長休之後充能)
N7ioD8l4.description: 德蘭尼在他的回合採取一個額外的動作。

IN2WlAUJ.name: 殘暴
IN2WlAUJ.description: 德蘭尼在用一把近戰武器命中目標時會造成一顆額外的傷害骰（已包含在攻擊條目）。

qe7p1Mwd.name: 矮人韌性
qe7p1Mwd.description: 德蘭尼在對抗毒素的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

zLMKBhwd.name: 不屈 (短休或長休之後充能)
zLMKBhwd.description: 德蘭尼可以重骰他失敗的豁免檢定。若他這麼做，則他必須使用新的擲骰結果。

j74ypNcG.name: 回氣 (短休或長休之後充能)
j74ypNcG.description: 德蘭尼能夠以一個附贈動作回復16 (1d10 + 11)點生命值。

PT1hHf5J.name: 特殊裝備
PT1hHf5J.description: 德蘭尼穿戴了一個用以控制他構裝盾衛的控制護符，以及一枚寒冰抗性戒指。他同時攜帶了一瓶霜巨人之力藥水。

E7TMrQGp.name: E7TMrQGp
E7TMrQGp.description: 德蘭尼進行三次巨斧攻擊。

BpdNlXYA.name: BpdNlXYA
BpdNlXYA.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) 劈砍傷害。

zGdf1gVE.name: 召喚魔蝠 (長休之後充能)
zGdf1gVE.description: 藉由從煙斗噴吐煙霧，艾利札可以使用一個動作來施放召喚次級元素生物。若他這麼做，則他將召喚出四個煙魔蝠。

5bukh147.name: 5bukh147
5bukh147.description: mw,rw 命中6，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

EternalFlameGuardian.name: 永焰守護者 Eternal Flame Guardian

sGyJwzNi.name: 烈焰武器 (短休或長休之後充能)
sGyJwzNi.description: 以一個附贈動作，永焰守護者可以使它所持握的一把近戰武器被烈焰纏繞。永焰守護者並不會被這陣火焰所傷害，且這陣烈焰將持續直到該永焰守護者的下個回合結束。當被烈焰纏繞時，這把武器將在命中時額外造成 3 (1d6)火焰傷害。

HZ17DyqN.name: HZ17DyqN
HZ17DyqN.description: 永焰守護者進行二次近戰攻擊。

XiK156vA.name: XiK156vA
XiK156vA.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) 劈砍傷害。

tAsUI2C3.name: tAsUI2C3
tAsUI2C3.description: rw 命中3，射程 100/400 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) 穿刺傷害。

EternalFlamePriest.name: 永焰祭司 Eternal Flame Priest

QJGV6aUL.name: QJGV6aUL
QJGV6aUL.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

84E2srGD.name: 變形者 (2/日)
84E2srGD.description: 深測者可以使用它的動作以變形成一個中型，由水構成的蛇，或變回它的真實型態。任何深測者所穿戴或攜帶的裝備將會在變形期間融入蛇型態之中，且直到它變為真實型態之前都無法使用。深測者會在4小時之後變回它的真實型態，除非它在這之前再一次消耗這個特性的使用次數。當深測者被擊暈昏迷或死亡時，它也將變回它的真實型態。

xJQu9OvX.name: 奧莉德拉之護甲 (限定人類型態)
xJQu9OvX.description: 深測者可以隨意施放法師護甲，且無須消耗任何材料構材。

RLuiaVty.name: RLuiaVty
RLuiaVty.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) 鈍擊傷害。若目標的體型為中型或更小，則它將被擒(逃脫DC 12)。直到擒抱結束前，目標被束縛，且深測者不能絞纏另一個目標。

DwbiZ9gM.name: DwbiZ9gM
DwbiZ9gM.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

SIXrzdjP.name: SIXrzdjP
SIXrzdjP.description: 羽風騎士進行二次近戰攻擊。

6gQWPZrf.name: 6gQWPZrf
6gQWPZrf.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2)劈砍傷害，或若以雙手使用時則造成 7 (1d10 + 2)劈砍傷害。

1ukjcmKN.name: 1ukjcmKN
1ukjcmKN.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)穿刺傷害，或若雙手使用以進行一次近戰攻擊時則造成 6 (1d8 + 2)穿刺傷害。

L4eDiqAr.name: 烈焰纏身
L4eDiqAr.description: 對於怒火者而言，溫暖版本的火焰護盾法術的持續時間變更為「直到解消」。在怒火者死亡之後，該火焰護盾仍會持續燃燒長達10分鐘，將其軀體焚燒殆盡。

gtSUZzxy.name: gtSUZzxy
gtSUZzxy.description: mw,rw 命中5，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

a8XWVLtN.name: 兩棲
a8XWVLtN.description: 加爾可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

BLc9YGMr.name: 傳奇抗性 (2/日)
BLc9YGMr.description: 若加爾在一次豁免檢定中失敗，他可以選擇改為使其成功。

8UOCcDx7.name: 水面行走
8UOCcDx7.description: 加爾可以在液態表面上站立並行走，就如同它們是固體表面一樣。

g1JwXq5c.name: 化水落
g1JwXq5c.description: 當加爾的生命值歸零時，他的身體將潰散成一池墨水，並迅速蒸發消散。任何他所穿戴或攜帶的東西都將被留在原地。

mV8vFSeU.name: mV8vFSeU
mV8vFSeU.description: 加爾進行二次近戰攻擊，一次爪抓、一次使用魔法武器水溺|pota。

avUEPR3G.name: avUEPR3G
avUEPR3G.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2)鈍擊傷害，且目標被擒(逃脫DC 13)。直到擒抱結束前，加爾不能對另一個生物使用鉗擊。

zSUTQqDs.name: zSUTQqDs
zSUTQqDs.description: mw,rw 命中7，觸及5呎 或射程20/60呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)穿刺傷害加 4 (1d8)寒冰傷害。

V7tMxFgC.name: 刺殺
V7tMxFgC.description: 在他的第一個回合期間，葛哈德對任何尚未採取過回合的生物所進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。且葛哈德命中任何被突襲生物的攻擊都視為暴擊。

QgKjTHON.name: 有限兩棲
QgKjTHON.description: 葛哈德可以在空氣和水中呼吸，但他每4小時必須至少回到水中一次以避免窒息。

xq0KZS16.name: 鯊心感應
xq0KZS16.description: 藉由有限的心靈感應，葛哈德可以用魔法對任何距離它120呎內的鯊魚下達命令。

7uky3m0l.name: 偷襲
7uky3m0l.description: 當葛哈德以武器攻擊命中一個目標時，若該攻擊檢定具有優勢，或者該攻擊檢定沒有劣勢且葛哈德有一個未無力的隊友距離目標5呎內，則葛哈德造成額外的14 (4d6)傷害。

JojMdNmT.name: JojMdNmT
JojMdNmT.description: 葛哈德進行三次攻擊，一次啃咬，二次短劍。

pIX39Qir.name: pIX39Qir
pIX39Qir.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一生物。 on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) 穿刺傷害。

mfEHtqR6.name: mfEHtqR6
mfEHtqR6.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一生物。  on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) 穿刺傷害。

baICvRFu.name: baICvRFu
baICvRFu.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一體型為中型或小型且葛哈德對其攻擊檢定有優勢的生物。 on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) 鈍擊傷害，且目標被擒(逃脫DC 15)。直到擒抱結束前，目標將無法呼吸，且葛哈德對它所進行的攻擊檢定都將帶有優勢。

NPZwjmRI.name: 反射閃避
NPZwjmRI.description: 若海倫芮成為一個允許她進行敏捷豁免以僅承受一半傷害的效果的目標，則海倫芮可以改為在豁免成功時不受任何傷害，且在豁免失敗時僅承受一半傷害。

37epBNqy.name: 震懾擊{@recharge 5}
37epBNqy.description: 當海倫芮以一次近戰武器攻擊命中目標時，目標必須成功通過一次DC 13的體質豁免，否則將被震懾直到海倫芮的下個回合結束。

BUPpe4j6.name: 無甲防禦
BUPpe4j6.description: 當海倫芮未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，她的AC將加上她的睿知調整值。

dD5ARJyU.name: 無甲移動
dD5ARJyU.description: 當海倫芮未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，她的移動速度將增加20呎（已包含在移動速度）。

eBVOrACD.name: 盲視
eBVOrACD.value: 60呎（超過半徑範圍則視作目盲）

QGtuvdqH.name: QGtuvdqH
QGtuvdqH.description: 海倫芮進行三次近戰攻擊。

jK47prGd.name: jK47prGd
jK47prGd.description: mw 命中7，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) 鈍擊傷害。

HowlingHatredInitiate.name: 嘯怨新晉者 Howling Hatred Initiate

R7kvtyU9.name: 導引之風 (短休或長休之後充能)
R7kvtyU9.description: 以一個附贈動作，在它的下個回合結束，嘯怨新晉者將在它的下一次遠程攻擊檢定中獲得優勢。

i6gsU2GQ.name: 屏息
i6gsU2GQ.description: 嘯怨新晉者可以屏住它的呼吸長達30分鐘。

oGCcrfJv.name: oGCcrfJv
oGCcrfJv.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

HowlingHatredPriest.name: 嘯怨祭司 Howling Hatred Priest

C9y3Fa7g.name: 屏息
C9y3Fa7g.description: 嘯怨祭司可以屏住它的呼吸長達30分鐘。

svJT3Nqz.name: svJT3Nqz
svJT3Nqz.description: 嘯怨祭司進行二次近戰攻擊、或是二次遠程攻擊.

IxYOEZ8i.name: IxYOEZ8i
IxYOEZ8i.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) 劈砍傷害。

GvzlOe2h.name: GvzlOe2h
GvzlOe2h.description: mw,rw 命中5，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

wrhNxvTV.name: 無甲防禦
wrhNxvTV.description: 當颶風未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，它的AC將加上它的睿知調整值。

w27Wlobv.name: 無甲移動
w27Wlobv.description: 當颶風未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，它的移動速度將增加15呎（已包含在移動速度）。

rQK5uZn6.name: rQK5uZn6
rQK5uZn6.description: 颶風進行兩次近戰攻擊。

Oy1ahTLN.name: Oy1ahTLN
Oy1ahTLN.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) 鈍擊傷害。

aLsuWGMS.name: 賦能攻擊
aLsuWGMS.description: 在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時，伊密克斯的猛擊攻擊被視作魔法攻擊。

zmYFd0aW.name: 火焰靈光
zmYFd0aW.description: 在伊密克斯的每個回合開始時，每個距離他10呎內的生物都將受到17 (5d6)火焰傷害，且靈光範圍內所有未被穿戴或攜帶的可燃物體也都將被點燃。一個觸碰伊密克斯或在距離它10呎內以一次近戰攻擊命中它的生物將受到 17 (5d6)火焰傷害，且在每個回合中當伊密克斯第一次進入其他生物所在的空間時，該生物也將受到這個傷害。命中伊密克斯的非魔法武器將在對他造成傷害之後立即被火焰摧毀。

hbKesFJQ.name: 火焰形體
hbKesFJQ.description: 伊密克斯可以進入敵對生物所在的空間，並停留在該處。此外，他也可以移動穿越最窄1吋，且火焰得以通過的狹窄空間而不用擠縮身體。

hlkbUajW.name: 照明
hlkbUajW.description: 伊密克斯會散發出60呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸60呎的微光光照。

p582TdFR.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
p582TdFR.description: 若伊密克斯在一次豁免檢定中失敗，它可以選擇改為使其成功。

CLsNnMhd.name: 魔法抗性
CLsNnMhd.description: 伊密克斯在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

vap6mbZP.name: vap6mbZP
vap6mbZP.description: 伊密克斯進行二次猛擊攻擊或二次烈焰爆破攻擊。

VWdrcHUp.name: VWdrcHUp
VWdrcHUp.description: mw 命中12，觸及10呎，單一目標。 on hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) 鈍擊傷害加 18 (5d6) 火焰傷害。

zlMHnZsI.name: zlMHnZsI
zlMHnZsI.description: rs 命中12，射程250呎，單一目標。 on hit: 35 (10d6) 火焰傷害。

afDJmXyO.name: afDJmXyO
afDJmXyO.description: 伊密克斯召喚出最多三個火元素，且他每召喚出一個元素生物便會失去30點生命值。被召喚的元素生物有著全滿的生命值，會出現在距離伊密克斯100呎內的位置，且會在伊密克斯的生命值歸零時消失不見。

uFzOgC7x.name: 化土敗亡
uFzOgC7x.description: 當馬洛斯的生命值歸零時，他的身體將轉變成一攤泥濘並潰散成池。任何他所穿戴或攜帶的東西都將被留在原地。

t4TgNALp.name: 地土穿行
t4TgNALp.description: 馬洛斯可以在任何由泥土或石頭構成的困難地形上移動時將其視為普通地形。他也可以移動穿過堅硬的土壤或岩石，就如同它們是困難地形一樣。若他在土壤或岩石內部結束他的回合，則他將被彈到距離他之前佔據空間最近的位置。

Revun31j.name: 傳奇抗性 (2/日)
Revun31j.description: 若馬洛斯在一次豁免檢定中失敗，他可以選擇改為使其成功。

ovZ5JkFB.name: 石化凝視
ovZ5JkFB.description: 當一個可以看見馬洛斯雙眼的生物在距離馬洛斯30呎內的位置開始它的回合，且若馬洛斯不處於無力並可以看見該生物，馬洛斯就可以強迫它進行一次DC 14的體質豁免。若此豁免失敗且檢定結果與目標值差距5點或更多，則該生物將瞬間被石化。除此之外，一個豁免失敗的生物將會開始轉變成石頭並因此被束縛。被束縛的生物必須在它的下個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定。若豁免成功則此效果結束。若豁免失敗則該生物將被石化。這個石化狀態將持續直到該生物被高等復原術法術或其他魔法給解放。

JPSOXzTZ.name: JPSOXzTZ
JPSOXzTZ.description: 馬洛斯進行三次攻擊，一次蛇髮，二次使用魔法武器鐵牙|pota。

2DHugymX.name: 2DHugymX
2DHugymX.description: mw 命中6，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)穿刺傷害加 14 (4d6) 毒素傷害。

3gsS5toB.name: 3gsS5toB
3gsS5toB.description: mw 命中9，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)穿刺傷害加 4 (1d8) 雷鳴傷害。

ZS4ei3RG.name: 地面行走
ZS4ei3RG.description: 移動穿過泥土或石頭構成的困難地形不會使莫拉消耗額外的移動速度。

1lzS2IcP.name: 1lzS2IcP
1lzS2IcP.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1)鈍擊傷害，或若以雙手使用時則造成 5 (1d8 + 1) 鈍擊傷害。

tGIsEyVS.name: 賦能攻擊
tGIsEyVS.description: 在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時，歐格莫克的猛擊攻擊被視作魔法攻擊。

gGW7NZqT.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
gGW7NZqT.description: 若歐格莫克在一次豁免檢定中失敗，他可以選擇改為使其成功。

VcGmRBu4.name: 魔法抗性
VcGmRBu4.description: 歐格莫克在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

n4uI9AKE.name: 攻城怪物
n4uI9AKE.description: 歐格莫克的近戰和遠程武器攻擊將對物體和建築物造成兩倍的傷害。

Fz85DQTu.name: Fz85DQTu
Fz85DQTu.description: 歐格莫克進行二次猛擊攻擊。

Fvp3g9I7.name: Fvp3g9I7
Fvp3g9I7.description: mw 命中14，觸及15呎，單一目標。 on hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) 鈍擊傷害。

d28IZVvQ.name: d28IZVvQ
d28IZVvQ.description: rw 命中6，射程500呎，單一目標。 on hit: 46 (7d10 + 8) 鈍擊傷害。若目標為一個生物，則它必須成功通過一次DC 23的力量豁免，否則被擊倒伏地。

mQuetFjk.name: mQuetFjk
mQuetFjk.description: 歐格莫克召喚出最多三個土元素，且他每召喚出一個元素生物便會失去30點生命值。被召喚的元素生物有著全滿的生命值，會出現在距離歐格莫克100呎內的位置，且會在歐格莫克的生命值歸零時消失不見。

YHLztR3c.name: 賦能攻擊
YHLztR3c.description: 在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時，奧莉德拉的猛擊攻擊被視作魔法攻擊。

W3iFxhkA.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
W3iFxhkA.description: 若奧莉德拉在一次豁免檢定中失敗，她可以選擇改為使其成功。

leDNTISs.name: 魔法抗性
leDNTISs.description: 奧莉德拉在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

8ItxgHLw.name: 流水形體
8ItxgHLw.description: 奧莉德拉可以進入一個敵對生物所在的空間並在該處停下。她也可以移動穿越最窄1吋的狹窄空間而不用擠縮身體。

TGxZlvhw.name: TGxZlvhw
TGxZlvhw.description: 奧莉德拉進行二次猛擊攻擊或二次水流噴射攻擊。

jFJc0ZyS.name: jFJc0ZyS
jFJc0ZyS.description: mw 命中11，觸及10呎，單一目標。 on hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) 鈍擊傷害，且目標被擒(逃脫DC 19)。奧莉德拉可以同時擒抱最多四個目標。當奧莉德拉移動時，所有被她擒抱的生物也都將跟著她移動。

2w1d47I9.name: 2w1d47I9
2w1d47I9.description: rw 命中12，射程120呎，單一目標。 on hit: 21 (6d6)鈍擊傷害，且若目標沒能成功通過一次DC 19的力量豁免，則目標將被擊倒伏地。

6DOlTR8s.name: 6DOlTR8s
6DOlTR8s.description: 奧莉德拉召喚出最多三個水元素，且她每召喚出一個元素生物便會失去30點生命值。被召喚的元素生物有著全滿的生命值，會出現在距離奧莉德拉100呎內的位置，且會在奧莉德拉的生命值歸零時消失不見。

JOaFRcSW.name: 寒顫迷霧
JOaFRcSW.description: 當它活著的時候，獨眼顫慄者會在它周圍10呎內的範圍內投射出一股寒冷的迷霧。如果獨眼顫慄者對該區域內的生物造成了傷害，則該生物將額外受到5 (1d10)寒冰傷害。

75RHudqJ.name: 75RHudqJ
75RHudqJ.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) 穿刺傷害。

GrNlf3YW.name: GrNlf3YW
GrNlf3YW.description: 獨眼顫慄者從它空洞的眼眶中施放冷凍射線。若它命中，則目標將同時被束縛。被這個方式束縛的目標可以藉由採取一個動作，並成功通過一次DC 13的力量豁免以解除這個狀態。

DvM41VYP.name: 殘怖收割
DvM41VYP.description: 每回合一次，當奧瑞歐斯以1環或更高環的法術殺死一個或更多的生物時，他將回復等同於該法術環階二倍的生命值。

HEFprhGC.name: 迅捷活化 (長休之後充能)
HEFprhGC.description: 當一個活著且體型為中型或小型的類人生物在距離奧瑞歐斯30呎內時死亡，則他將可以在他的下個回合以一個動作對該類人生物的屍體施放活化死屍，而非以該法術原本的施法時間施放。

5L2eo1dY.name: 5L2eo1dY
5L2eo1dY.description: mw 命中3，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) 穿刺傷害。

X8j6IyY1.name: 熾灼盔甲
X8j6IyY1.description: 爆刃的護甲相當熾熱。任何擒抱爆刃、或被擒於爆刃的生物都將在該生物的回合結束時受到5 (1d10)火焰傷害。

36Sa8rRI.name: 碎鎧爆裂
36Sa8rRI.description: 當爆刃的生命值歸零時，它胸中的熾焰法球將會爆炸，摧毀爆刃的身體並使它的盔甲爆裂成破片。每個在爆刃爆炸時距離它10呎內的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 12的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗將受到21 (6d6)穿刺傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半的傷害。

abwNvu3s.name: abwNvu3s
abwNvu3s.description: 爆刃進行三次近戰攻擊。

G2P4e10U.name: G2P4e10U
G2P4e10U.description: mw,rw 命中6，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)穿刺傷害，或若雙手使用以進行一次近戰攻擊時則造成 7 (1d8 + 3) 穿刺傷害，再加上 3 (1d6)火焰傷害。

RKbHuaXG.name: 無甲防禦
RKbHuaXG.description: 當聖石僧未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，它的AC將加上它的睿知調整值。

liKzRgmD.name: 無甲移動
liKzRgmD.description: 當聖石僧未穿戴任何護甲且未持用盾牌時，它的移動速度將增加10呎（已包含在移動速度）。

Tf1jlyxL.name: Tf1jlyxL
Tf1jlyxL.description: 聖石僧進行二次近戰攻擊。

l4shpWj5.name: l4shpWj5
l4shpWj5.description: mw 命中4，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) 鈍擊傷害。

96wAB8LX.name: 兩棲
96wAB8LX.description: 索勒可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

34pQdVBn.name: 34pQdVBn
34pQdVBn.description: mw,rw 命中3，觸及5呎 或射程d 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) 穿刺傷害。

8LVkjYiH.name: 8LVkjYiH
8LVkjYiH.description: mw,rw 命中4，觸及5呎 或射程 20/60 呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) 穿刺傷害。

Ecdr2pka.name: 死亡自爆
Ecdr2pka.description: 當融石者死亡時，它將化作岩石並爆裂成碎塊，變成一堆冒著煙的石礫。每個在融石者爆炸時距離它10呎內的生物都必須進行一次DC 14的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到11 (2d10)鈍擊傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半的傷害。

V901Rf3o.name: V901Rf3o

value.value: 1d6 + 2 @鈍擊 @融石者也可以消耗一個法術位以造成額外 @鈍擊 @點

V901Rf3o.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) 鈍擊傷害。融石者也可以消耗一個法術位以造成額外傷害，1環法術位將造成2d8鈍擊傷害，每比1環高一環則再額外造成1d8點傷害。

ThurlMerosska.name: 圖爾．莫羅斯卡 Thurl Merosska

tgVq5f4O.name: tgVq5f4O
tgVq5f4O.description: 圖爾進行二次近戰攻擊。

zUr2tLYf.name: zUr2tLYf
zUr2tLYf.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) 劈砍傷害。

sR7H1BrU.name: sR7H1BrU
sR7H1BrU.description: mw 命中5，觸及10呎，單一目標。 on hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

Q8HTU0fj.name: 火葬
Q8HTU0fj.description: 當凡妮弗的生命值歸零時，她的身體將在瞬間被火焰和煙霧給吞噬殆盡。任何她所穿戴或攜帶的東西都將被留在原地。

NcOuznMS.name: 傳奇抗性 (2/日)
NcOuznMS.description: 若凡妮弗在一次豁免檢定中失敗，她可以選擇改為使其成功。

GvHRJrdP.name: GvHRJrdP
GvHRJrdP.description: mw,rw 命中9，觸及5呎 或 射程20/60呎, 單一目標。 on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5)穿刺傷害加 7 (2d6)火焰傷害。

rA5I6gz3.name: 英勇奉獻
rA5I6gz3.description: 威甘在對抗魅惑和恐懼的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

ycgPYCG1.name: ycgPYCG1
ycgPYCG1.description: 威甘使用他的木拐杖進行二次攻擊。

7clrfGeo.name: 7clrfGeo
7clrfGeo.description: mw 命中0 (橡棍術時命中4)，觸及5呎，單一目標。 on hit: 1 (1d4 - 1)鈍擊傷害，或若使用橡棍術時 6 (1d8 + 2) 鈍擊傷害。

RqTSDnVs.name: 精類血統
RqTSDnVs.description: 溫德哈羅在對抗魅惑的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且魔法無法使她入睡。

PtHlVfx3.name: PtHlVfx3
PtHlVfx3.description: 溫德哈羅進行二次近戰攻擊。

BDeiOZVu.name: BDeiOZVu
BDeiOZVu.description: mw 命中5，觸及5呎，單一生物。 on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) 穿刺傷害。

foHlFxTy.name: 氣態形體
foHlFxTy.description: 延希賓可以進入一個敵對生物所在的空間並在該處停下。他也可以移動穿越最窄1吋，且空氣得以通過的的狹窄空間而不用擠縮身體。

hkqjCxDQ.name: 賦能攻擊
hkqjCxDQ.description: 在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時，延希賓的猛擊攻擊被視作魔法攻擊。

gRNVP24W.name: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)
gRNVP24W.description: 若延希賓在一次豁免檢定中失敗，他可以選擇改為使其成功。

ZFIQ8p9E.name: 魔法抗性
ZFIQ8p9E.description: 延希賓在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

qZJ9RwEu.name: qZJ9RwEu
qZJ9RwEu.description: 延希賓進行二次猛擊攻擊。

jvbtrZFC.name: jvbtrZFC
jvbtrZFC.description: mw 命中14，觸及10呎，單一目標。 on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) 力場傷害加 10 (3d6)閃電傷害。

6n1Dorcq.name: 6n1Dorcq

value.value: 雷鳴霹靂 (短休或長休之後充能)
9d6 @雷鳴 @則該生物只受到一半的

6n1Dorcq.description: 延希賓釋放出一道以他自己為中心，籠罩整個100呎半徑球體範圍內的可怕雷鳴。範圍內的所有其他生物都必須成功通過一次DC 24的體質豁免，否則將受到 31 (9d6)雷鳴傷害，且陷入耳聾長達1分鐘。若豁免成功，則該生物只受到一半的傷害，且只會陷入耳聾狀態直到延希賓的下個回合開始。

4bvNswpq.name: 4bvNswpq
4bvNswpq.description: 延希賓可以變形成一個中型的類人生物。當處於變形型態時，他的身邊將環繞著微風，他的雙眼蒼白而混濁，且他將失去氣態形體特性。他可以維持這個變形型態最多長達1小時。變回他的真實型態需要採取一個動作。

mJXAw6aN.name: mJXAw6aN
mJXAw6aN.description: 延希賓召喚出最多三個氣元素，且他每召喚出一個元素生物便會失去30點生命值。被召喚的元素生物有著全滿的生命值，會出現在距離延希賓100呎內的位置，且會在延希賓的生命值歸零時消失不見。

Inscrutable.name: Inscrutable
Inscrutable.description: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The sphinx makes a ram attack and two claw attacks.

Ram.name: Ram
Ram.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The manticore makes two attacks, one with its bite and one with its claws.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The serpopard has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: If the serpopard moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the serpopard can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

saBhC1pY.name: 兩棲
saBhC1pY.description: The homarid can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The homarid makes two claw attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The homarid has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The kavu makes two claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

RakingCharge.name: Raking Charge
RakingCharge.description: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one rend attack against it as a bonus action.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

Rend.name: Rend

FalseAppearance.description: While the creepy doll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate doll.

Multiattack.description: The creepy doll makes one attack with its scissors and uses Psychic Assault.

Scissors.name: Scissors
Scissors.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

PsychicAssault.name: PsychicAssault
PsychicAssault.description: The creepy doll targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it that has a brain. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Also on a failure, roll 3d6. If the total equals or exceeds the target's Intelligence score, that score is reduced to 0. The target is stunned until it regains at least one point of Intelligence, as from the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

BodyExchange.name: BodyExchange
BodyExchange.description: The creepy doll initiates an Intelligence contest with an incapacitated humanoid within 5 feet of it. If it wins the contest, the creepy doll's spirit inhabits the target's body while the target's spirit is placed into the creepy doll's body. The creepy doll controls the target's body completely. It retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The target retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma while inhabiting the creepy doll's body.

EtherealSight.description: The geist can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The geist can move through other creatures

GeistPowers.name: Geist Powers
GeistPowers.description: Geists are as varied as the humans they were in life. In addition to the traits and actions all geists possess, an individual geist might have any of the following special characteristics.

GeistPowers:IntangibleVirtue.name: Geist Powers: Intangible Virtue
GeistPowers:IntangibleVirtue.description: A living creature possessed by a white-aligned geist gains immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. While the creature is possessed, the geist can allow it to take control of its body, but the geist can regain control at any time (no action required).

GeistPowers:HorrifyingVisage.name: Geist Powers: Horrifying Visage
GeistPowers:HorrifyingVisage.description: Black-aligned geists can make themselves terrible to behold, even when they are possessing the living. Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the geist that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4    ×    10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this geist's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

WitheringTouch.name: WitheringTouch
WitheringTouch.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target on hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

Etherealness.name: Etherealness
Etherealness.description: The geist enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description: One creature that the geist can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the geist; the geist then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The geist now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The geist can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the geist ends it as a bonus action, or the geist is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the geist reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this geist's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends. The geist can instead target the corpse of a creature, effectively using its own life force to animate the corpse as a zombie. The animated corpse uses zombie statistics and returns to death if the geist ends the possession.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

AversionofFire.name: Aversion of Fire
AversionofFire.description: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

LightningAbsorption.name: Lightning Absorption
LightningAbsorption.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

boV89awz.name: 魔法抗性
boV89awz.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

SkaabCharacteristics.name: Skaab Characteristics
SkaabCharacteristics.description: The most basic skaabs are simply flesh golems, as described in the Monster Manual. But the aspiration of every skaberen is to produce a truly unique masterpiece, a goal that might see a stitcher create golems with one of the following special characteristics.

SkaabCharacteristic:ArmorPlating.name: Skaab Characteristic: Armor Plating
SkaabCharacteristic:ArmorPlating.description: Increase the skaab's Armor Class to 14 and increase its challenge rating to 6 (2,300 XP).

SkaabCharacteristic:SixArms.name: Skaab Characteristic: Six Arms
SkaabCharacteristic:SixArms.description: The skaab's multiattack action allows it to make three slam attacks. Increase its challenge rating to 6 (2,300 XP).

SkaabCharacteristic:ThreeHeads.name: Skaab Characteristic: Three Heads
SkaabCharacteristic:ThreeHeads.description: The skaab has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, deafened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. (Its challenge rating doesn't change.)

SkaabCharacteristic:SkaabGoliath.name: Skaab Characteristic: Skaab Goliath
SkaabCharacteristic:SkaabGoliath.description: This skaab has three heads, six arms, and armor plating. Increase its challenge rating to 7 (2,900 XP).

SkaabCharacteristic:WingedSkaab.name: Skaab Characteristic: Winged Skaab
SkaabCharacteristic:WingedSkaab.description: The skaab has a flying speed of 30 feet.

ElderVampires:Flight.name: Elder Vampires: Flight

A creature that can see the vampire can take an action to visually inspect it, ending the mental effect on itself and seeing the vampire's true form with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check.

Howlpack:Vildin.description: Vildin Rampage (Canid Form Only). When the werewolf reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

SneakAttack(1/Turn).name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
SneakAttack(1/Turn).description: Darz deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Darz that isn't incapacitated and Darz doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description: In his youth, Darz was a member of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild in Waterdeep. After serving ten years in prison for his crimes, he cut all ties to the city and moved north to be a campground caretaker.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Darz carries twenty sling stones.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: Zalto deals double damage to objects and structures.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Zalto wears a ring of lightning resistance.

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description: When Zalto enters any enemy's space for the first time on a turn, the enemy must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Zalto makes two maul attacks.

wOd0yFJI.name: wOd0yFJI
wOd0yFJI.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description: The daughter of a Waterdhavian trader and a tavern server, Duvessa has her mother's talent for negotiation and her father's charm. As the first woman to serve as Town Speaker of Bryn Shander, and a young one at that, she has much to prove.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage. Duvessa carries only one dagger.

DwarvenResilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
DwarvenResilience.description: Ghelryn has advantage on saving throws against poison.

GiantSlayer.name: Giant Slayer
GiantSlayer.description: Any weapon attack that Ghelryn makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description: The blacksmith Ghelryn has a good heart, but he hates orcs and giants—hates them with a fiery passion. He considers it the solemn duty of all dwarves to cave in their skulls!

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Ghelryn makes two battleaxe attacks.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

LegendaryResistance(1/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(1/Day).description: If Harshnag fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

WeightedNet.name: WeightedNet
WeightedNet.description: rw 5 to hit, ranged 20/60 ft., one Small, Medium, or Large creature. on hit: The target is restrained until it escapes the net. Any creature can use its action to make a DC 17 Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 12) destroys the net and frees the target.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.

Gurt'sGreataxe.name: Gurt'sGreataxe
Gurt'sGreataxe.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) slashing damage, or 39 (5d12 + 7) slashing damage if the target is human.

Rock.description: rw 9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
